AURIS NOBLE LLC

Program Manager

Critical Materials Recovery, Refining and Manufacturing

Company: Auris Noble LLC

Title: Program Manager

Position: Full Time w/ Benefits

Who We Are

Auris Noble is a vertically integrated recovery and refining company that manages high-value critical and strategic materials generated by aerospace, defense, telecommunications, advanced manufacturing, and other industries. We develop science-driven solutions for complex and previously underserved material streams containing precious, refractory, rare earth, and strategic metals. Our capabilities span laboratory development, analytical chemistry, pilot operations, commercial-scale chemical processing, thermal treatment, metal recovery, and production of refined materials. Auris Noble operates multiple facilities and produces materials under an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system.

Position Overview

The Program Manager coordinates technical and business teams, maintains the performance baseline, communicates priorities to various team leaders, and ensures that commitments are translated into timely, accurate, and supportable deliverables on existing multi-year federally funded projects.

This position will support one or more company growth programs involving facility expansion, process scale-up, equipment installation and commissioning, recovery and separation of critical materials from nickel-based superalloy feedstocks, and transition of new or improved processes into sustained production.

Position and Benefits

Auris Noble offers a full-time, on-site position with benefits that may include health, dental and vision insurance; paid time off and holidays; 401(k) matching; quarterly bonuses; annual profit sharing; and a planned annual plant shutdown, subject to plan terms and company policy.

Job Responsibilities

● Develop and maintain the integrated program plan, work breakdown structure, schedule, milestone calendar, responsibility matrix, budget alignment, risk register, and reporting cadence.

● Coordinate plant, engineering, chemistry, construction, maintenance, operations, quality, ESH, finance, procurement, IT, and contracts activities across interdependent workstreams via effective and proactive collaboration with the associated leads in each area.

● Facilitate kickoff, weekly team, monthly leadership, risk, change-control, and milestone-readiness reviews and drive closure of decisions and actions.

● Track requirements, approvals, and documentation for capital purchases, construction, commissioning, qualification, pilot production, product sampling, production targets, and final closeout.

● Identify schedule, cost, resource, technical, supply-chain, and compliance risks to develop and manage the critical path; assign owners and monitor mitigation plans.

● Coordinate draft preparation and internal review of presentations, project plans, schedules, quarterly reports, annual reports, invoices, production and quality summaries, and final technical reports.

● Maintain objective evidence supporting deliverables, milestone completion, costs, approvals, and technical acceptance criteria.

● Implement disciplined change control for scope, schedule, budget, requirements, assumptions, and technical baselines.

● Communicate status, forecast, decisions, and emerging issues clearly to executives, project teams, customers, and partners.

● Support workforce planning, subcontractor coordination, customer visits, audits, and project closeout.

Education, Training and Experience

● Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, business, project management, or related discipline.

● 5+ years of program, project, operations, engineering, or manufacturing leadership experience.

● Demonstrated success managing complex cross-functional projects involving capital equipment, construction, facilities management, process development, or production.

● Strong schedule, risk, budget, meeting, documentation, and executive-communication skills.

● Ability to understand technical work sufficiently to challenge assumptions, identify dependencies, and communicate progress accurately.

Preferred Qualifications

● Project Management Professional or comparable certification.

● Experience in chemical processing, specialty metals, advanced materials, aerospace, defense, or government-funded manufacturing programs.

● Experience with earned-value concepts, integrated master schedules, federal project deliverables, or milestone-based payments.

● Experience with commissioning, qualification, production ramp-up, ISO 9001, or supply-chain reporting.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

● Able to communicate clearly and effectively in writing and in person.

● Able to organize work, manage changing priorities, and collaborate across technical and business functions.

● Demonstrates sound judgment, attention to detail, initiative, and commitment to safe, ethical work.

● Proficient with Microsoft Office and able to learn company systems.

● Able to protect confidential, proprietary, customer, and controlled project information.

Work Environment and Other Requirements

● This position is eligible for a fully remote work schedule. However, periodic (quarterly or more) travel may be required for site visits, in-person meetings, and enhanced coordination. A candidate capable of hybrid work (up to 1 -2 days/week in the Warren, OH location) would be a strong plus.

● Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Auris Noble LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, consistent with applicable law. This description identifies the general nature and level of work expected and is not intended to contain every duty or responsibility. Responsibilities may evolve as company and project needs change.

Flexible work from home options available.

title: Junior K9 Handler
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Junior Handler will be responsible for screening cargo in compliance with TSA rules and regulations. The Junior Handler will be required to complete a 4–8-weeks minimum team training course and certification prior to mobilization to the assigned location.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in CCSP related training to search cargo and identify potential threats
  • Conduct authorized representative duties related to X-Ray, physical search, and explosive trace detection as needed
  • Perform Junior Handler duties while commanding a trained working dog
  • Responsible for maintaining training records
  • Responsible for maintaining training records, care, and maintenance of assigned certified canine. The assigned canine must be permitted to live inside the employee’s residence. The employee’s residence must be adequate, indoor, and climate-controlled for the canine. The canine living area at the employee’s residence is subject to reoccurring inspections.
  • Must maintain all job-related certifications and required security clearances
  • Must be willing to operate company vehicle (during on-site training)
  • Work conditions can vary from a busy training environment to fieldwork, both subject to frequent interruptions. Frequent work outside and in inclement weather conditions is required, including heat, cold, and humidity. May be exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals and vibration. Work hours will be dictated by the customers agreed upon schedule. Nights, weekends, and holiday hours will be required, and the work schedule will vary. Travel may also be required.
  • Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • U.S. Citizenship is required
  • Must have held citizenship for a minimum of three years prior to date of application
  • Must be able to obtain a Known Traveler Number (KTN) within four to six weeks of employment
  • Must be able to obtain a Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) badge within four to six weeks of employment
  • Must be able to obtain a Security Threat Assessment (STA) for Airport Badge within four to six weeks of employment
  • Must have adequate transportation to transport assigned Canine and Crate (inside the vehicle) to/from assigned work location; transportation must have operational climate control
  • Must be able to pass the applicable Contract Testing and Certifications for the program within four to eight weeks of employment; candidate must maintain the certification requirements
  • Must have a valid US drivers license and satisfactory driver record.
  • Drivers license must be compliant with REAL ID standards or possess a valid U.S. passport in addition to a valid drivers license.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage time and multiple priorities to completion
  • Problem solving skills with an analytical thought process
  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
  • Must be able to lift and carry various items weighing up to 100 lbs. Requires standing for long periods of time in all weather conditions. Requires intermittent sitting, walking, running, climbing, squatting, stretching, bending, and kneeling. Requires constant use of hands and fingers to feel, handle or operate objects, tools, or controls, and reach with hands and arms

description:

Job Summary: A Fire Sprinkler Service Technician is responsible for inspecting, testing, repairing, and maintaining fire sprinkler systems to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and optimal safety for occupants. Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of wet, dry and pre-action systems fire sprinkler systems, to identify and address any issues or deficiencies, as per NFPA 25 requirements

  • Inspect Fire pump assemblies, including testing flow rates, pressure levels, and mechanical integrity
  • Respond promptly to service calls and emergency requests, diagnosing problems and implementing solutions to restore system functionality.
  • Document all service activities accurately and thoroughly, including inspection reports, work orders, and parts usage, and customer notes, using the Service Trade operations platform.
  • Work closely with Deficiency Sellers to provide detailed inspection reports, material needs, and other job-related notes, to prepare and deliver repair estimates in a timely manner
  • Interact professionally with clients to schedule work, discuss inspection findings, address any concerns or questions, and provide recommendations for system upgrades or improvements
  • Work closely with Service Coordinator(s) to optimize work orders, material requisitions, and job scheduling, focusing on efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment, always adhering to safety guidelines, protocols, and procedures.

  • Participants must be able to attend the full six- to eight-week training without disruption or absences. Unexcused absences could disqualify participants from continuing the program and require repayment of the cost of training.
  • Participants must agree to a commitment of working as a Mesa Airline Aircraft Dispatcher for at least two (2) years upon successful completion of the Aircraft Dispatcher certification and onboarding training as an aircraft dispatcher at Mesa or be subject to a repayment of the cost of training.
  • Apprentices will earn an hourly rate of $15.00 through the certification process. Upon successful completion of the program and upon hire at Mesa Airlines, aircraft dispatchers will earn a starting hourly rate of $22.00 with opportunities for internal advancement regularly available.
  • Internal applicants must be in good standing in their current role to be considered for the Aircraft Dispatcher Apprenticeship Program.
  • Internal applicants will maintain company longevity within the apprenticeship program and in the aircraft dispatcher role.

AIRCRAFT DISPATCHER POSITION PURPOSE

Aircraft dispatchers are in the system operations control center which is the heartbeat of any airline. Aircraft dispatchers plan routes of flight, file flight plans with the FAA and communicate critical safety information to pilots during flight to help navigate weather or other operations challenges.

An aircraft dispatcher authorizes, regulates, and controls airline flights according to government regulations and Company policy to expedite and ensure flight safety. Aircraft dispatchers work closely with our pilots to ensure the safety of our crew, passengers, and aircraft on our more than 1,000 daily flights in the U.S., Canada, and Caribbean.

An aircraft dispatcher is a critical part of our team for each takeoff and landing, helping our airline achieve operational excellence, while maintaining a focus on the highest level of safety.

title: Intermittent (part-time) Background Investigator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Work cases throughout the geographic area of responsibility and travel to various places of employment, residence and education institutions.

Candidate must be local to El Centro or Imperial, California

HOURLY RATE

The hourly rate for this position is $25.00 - $44.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, education, contract requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • H.S. Diploma or equivalent;
  • Minimum of 1 year within the last five (5) years of investigations experience at the federal, state, or local level of government;
  • Must have some direct FIS Experience;
  • Reliable personal vehicle, valid driver's license, and satisfactory driving record;
  • Willing to travel on temporary duty assignments as needed (by car or plane);
  • Successfully pass all required training;

  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in oral, written, diagram, or schedule form;

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Conduct in-person, one-on-one subject interviews to obtain factual information about the individual's character, in accordance with agency guidelines and instructions.

Coverage area varies and could include some extended drives. Work hours vary depending on availability of leads and do not always fall within normal business hours, to include potential weekend hours or third-shift appointments.

title: Membership Assoc Presale NCO
description:
ABOUT US
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym--we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!
JOB SUMMARY
At 24 Hour Fitness, we're passionate about inspiring and empowering our members to live fit and healthy lives. Our new clubs are the next chapter of that mission: first-of-its-kind flagship destinations bringing together best-in-class fitness, wellness, recovery and hospitality. As a member of the founding team, the Membership Associate is one of the first faces of our new locations, building the club's membership base one conversation and one Founding Member at a time, and helping shape how the club looks, sounds and serves its members from day one.
The Membership Associate delivers an outstanding and well-rounded sales and service experience to all guests and members through a compelling approach of offering membership, fitness and retail products and services. The Membership Associate builds relationships and translates the value of new locations and 24 Hour Fitness product and service offerings and has a strong focus on behaviors that drive member acquisition and retention. During presale and new club opening, the Membership Associate builds the club's founding membership base in the community; once the doors open, the Membership Associate carries that momentum onto the club floor, delivering successful guest and member engagement and attainment of sales revenue goals.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Presale and New Club Opening
  • Builds the club's founding membership base during the presale period by selling individual and Corporate Memberships against individual and team presale goals.
  • Prospects daily in the community through local business visits, canvassing, pop-up events, chamber and networking events, schools and community organizations.
  • Develops corporate partnerships with nearby employers and HR teams to enroll their employees as founding members.
  • Conducts preview tours and consultations at the presale location and virtually, using Company-provided presale materials.
  • Plans and supports presale and launch events, including VIP previews, community workouts, one-day sales events and the grand opening celebration.
  • Communicates founding offers and presale promotions clearly and accurately.
  • Logs every lead, appointment, tour and sale in the Lead Management System and reports daily activity against presale goals.
  • Supports grand opening readiness, including onboarding presold members, scheduling first visits and orientations, and transitioning to the club sales floor at opening.
Guest Experience and New Member Onboarding
  • Executes the Basecamp sales model with each guest and passionately relates how 24 Hour Fitness's products/services will satisfy their fitness needs.
  • Tours potential members through the club and describes the facility, equipment, services and amenities that directly tie back to their individual fitness needs and goals. Ensures all guests are registered through the digital kiosk.
  • Communicates membership and fitness offers in a clear and concise manner using Company-provided presentation tools.
  • Effectively and professionally enrolls guests using Company sales techniques and protocol.
  • Adheres to specific Membership Agreement Procedures (MAP) when enrolling members and guests.
  • Onboards new members and assists with all member retention activities in order to drive club profitability.
  • Consistently achieves or exceeds personal and team sales goals.
Prospecting and Lead Generation
  • Obtains leads externally from within the community using company-provided tools/programs (e.g., community outreach/local promotions, corporate sales on-sites).
  • Generates leads/new business internally through member promotions, referrals, the dissemination of guest passes, and contacting leads generated via phone.
  • Responsible for effectively setting appointments for all leads and potential new business opportunities.
  • Communicates and promotes local and global marketing campaigns to leads and members.
  • Manages and follows up on leads/new business by using a Lead Management System.
  • Executes a daily planner to track and plan for successful lead management and selling activities.
  • Consistently achieves or exceeds personal productivity goals.
Member Experience
  • Partners with Sales Leadership and the General Manager to provide a best-in-class, member-centric experience that strengthens member relationships and builds member retention.
  • Ensures members receive a friendly greeting/check-in and prompt attention to their needs.
  • Engages members with various fitness offerings including personal training, group exercise classes and 24GO digital content.
  • Maintains first-name relationships with members, serves as a resource for their questions or concerns, and connects them with the right 24 Hour Fitness resources as appropriate.
  • Provides a clean, friendly, well-maintained club to members and guests and helps new members become comfortable in the club.
Variable Compensation
Team Members in this role are eligible to participate in 24 Hour Fitness's Fitness Sales and Membership Sales Commission Plans. These plans reward exceptional service, incentivize success, and empower earning potential by aligning pay with your contributions.
Organization Relationships
Reports to the Sales and Service Manager. Works closely with the General Manager, marketing and the new club opening team during presale. Communicates and interacts with club members, prospective members, community and corporate partners, and outside/third party vendors. This position does not have any direct reports.
QUALIFICATIONS
Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  • Minimum 12 months of retail or fitness sales experience required.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with sales practices and techniques.
  • General understanding of the fitness industry.
  • Ability to work with computers.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate leads through outside sales, community outreach and networking.
  • Comfortable approaching new people and businesses face-to-face and closing the sale.
  • Independent, self-starter with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to operate Point of Sale (POS) System.
  • Knowledge of Membership System software preferred.
Minimum Educational Level/Certifications
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and Automated External Defibrillator (AED) certification from an approved organization is required (within 60 days of employment).
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Access to reliable transportation.
Work Experience and Qualifications
  • Presale, new club opening, outside sales or community/B2B sales experience preferred.
Physical Demands/Environmental Conditions
  • Ability to work in the club office and move about club floors and rooms.
  • Occasionally required to demonstrate or explain proper physical fitness activities, techniques and procedures.
  • Ability to communicate telephonically with members.
  • Ability to access and operate company computer systems including document preparation, data entry, and reading and interpreting general and financial reports from a computer database or email system.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the team member will be regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
  • Ability to work a varied schedule to support the needs of the business; frequent extended workdays, weekends, and holidays may be required.
  • Ability to work in a loud environment.
  • Ability to work off-site and outdoors at local businesses and community events for extended periods, including walking between locations.
Travel Requirement
  • Frequent local travel within the community during presale for lead generation, events and corporate outreach. Minimal travel may be required for training purposes.
BENEFITS AT 24
In line with our mission to create a healthier, happier world, we offer comprehensive benefits to help our team members do just that. We offer benefits such as paid time off, medical and dental coverage, 401(k) with match for qualifying positions, a free gym membership, and discounts on products and personal training. We also have a variety of Employee Resource Groups that you can connect with to participate in community events both in-person and virtually.

This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the qualifications, responsibilities, duties, and skills required. 24 Hour Fitness reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

title: Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) Engineer / Administrator
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) Engineer / Administrator

Austin, TX

Job description:

We are seeking a skilled Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) Engineer and Administrator with expertise in Linux system administration, RabbitMQ (RMQ) services, infrastructure management, and automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience troubleshooting PCF applications, leveraging monitoring tools like Wavefront, Splunk, or Datadog, and managing infrastructure components such as VMware vCenter. You will automate workflows using Concourse pipelines and scripting (Python, Shell) while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and application performance.


Key Responsibilities:


• Platform Management: Deploy, configure, and maintain Pivotal Cloud Foundry environments to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
• PCF Application Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve issues with PCF-hosted applications, including performance bottlenecks, runtime errors, and deployment failures, ensuring minimal downtime.
• Linux Administration: Manage and troubleshoot Linux-based systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu) hosting PCF and related services, ensuring security and optimization.
• RabbitMQ (RMQ) Services: Administer and optimize RabbitMQ messaging services, including setup, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
• Monitoring and Observability: Implement and manage monitoring solutions using tools like Wavefront, Splunk, Datadog, or similar to proactively identify and resolve system and application issues.
• Infrastructure Management: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to manage VMware vCenter and related virtualization technologies supporting PCF deployments.
• Automation: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Concourse for automated deployments and infrastructure management.
• Scripting: Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python, Shell, or other scripting languages to streamline operations.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers, DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams, to align on project goals, troubleshoot issues, and drive operational excellence.
• Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation for system configurations, troubleshooting processes, automation workflows, and team collaboration protocols.


Required Skills and Qualifications:


• Experience:3 years of experience in Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) engineering and administration.
• Proven expertise in troubleshooting PCF applications, including identifying and resolving application-level issues in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong Linux system administration skills (RHEL, Ubuntu, or similar).
• Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ (RMQ) setup, configuration, and administration.
• Experience with monitoring tools such as Wavefront, Splunk, Datadog, or similar.
• Familiarity with VMware vCenter and virtualization infrastructure.
• Proven experience with Concourse CI/CD pipelines for automation.
• Proficiency in scripting languages like Python and Shell for automation and orchestration.
• Technical Skills:
• Deep understanding of PCF architecture, components (e.g., BOSH, Diego, Garden), and application deployment processes.
• Expertise in diagnosing and resolving PCF application issues, including log analysis and performance tuning.
• Strong knowledge of RabbitMQ configuration and performance optimization.
• Familiarity with infrastructure components, including vCenter, ESXi, and virtualization technologies.
• Experience with log aggregation, monitoring, and alerting tools (Wavefront, Splunk, Datadog, etc.).
• Proficiency in Concourse and scripting (Python, Bash) for automation.
• Knowledge of cloud-native concepts, microservices, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
• Soft Skills:
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills for application and system troubleshooting.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and manage multiple priorities.


Preferred Qualifications:


• Certifications in PCF (e.g., PCF Administrator), Linux (e.g., RHCE), or related cloud technologies.
• Experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for hybrid or multi-cloud deployments.
• Knowledge of additional automation tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins.
• Familiarity with security best practices for cloud and messaging systems.

title: Fire Inspector
description:

To assist the Fire and Life Safety Educational Program in the areas of public fire safety education and other related services for the protection of life and property from fire or other disaster. This position involves administrative work in the performance and direction of activities including compliance with administrative codes, laws and ordinances, policies, procedures and/or special instructions of the Client and Statement of Work (SOW).

RESPONSIBILITIES

Hazardous conditions shall be reported, logged, corrected, and sent to the client Security Manager as required per the current SOW

title: Chief of Fire and Emergency Services
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Chief of Fire and Emergency Services is responsible for the leadership, administration, operational readiness, and strategic management of all Fire and Emergency Services operations supporting the Turkey Base Operations Support (T-BOS) contract. This position directs fire suppression, aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF), hazardous materials (HAZMAT) response, technical rescue, fire prevention, emergency preparedness, and life safety programs in support of installation operations and mission requirements.

*This position is contingent upon award of a contract*

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide overall leadership and management of Fire and Emergency Services operations supporting installation and airfield activities.
  • Direct emergency response operations involving structural fires, aircraft incidents, hazardous materials releases, confined space emergencies, rescue operations, medical emergencies, and other all-hazards incidents.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD 6055.06-M, contract requirements, and installation policies.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain departmental policies, procedures, emergency response plans, and standard operating guidelines.
  • Manage and supervise fire department personnel.
  • Oversee Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting (ARFF) operations to ensure compliance with support requirements.
  • Ensure all personnel maintain required certifications and qualifications for emergency response duties.
  • Coordinate with military leadership, tenant organizations, contractors, security personnel, medical services, and host nation agencies to support installation emergency management objectives.
  • Monitor operational readiness of fire apparatus, rescue equipment, communications systems, and fire protection infrastructure.
  • Conduct incident investigations, after-action reviews, and corrective action programs to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare operational reports, performance metrics, and executive briefings for contract leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of safety, accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
  • Work is based in a busy training environment and subject to frequent interruptions. Frequent outdoor work in inclement weather is required, including heat, cold, humidity, and rain. May be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, vibration, and toxic or caustic chemicals. Must wear PPE as required by Company safety standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active U.S. Secret Clearance
  • Associate’s Degree or higher in Fire Technology, Fire Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in fire protection operations
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, or equivalent senior fire service leadership position.
  • Current certifications meeting applicable requirements of DoD 6055.06-M for assigned duties.
  • Demonstrated experience managing structural firefighting, aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF), hazardous materials response, and confined space rescue operations.
  • Experience leading emergency response organizations in a military, government, aviation, industrial, or similarly complex operational environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and report preparation.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in a modern AI/ML stack with strong AI software engineering fundamentals, strong people leadership, and the ability to partner effectively across technology, data, product, operations, and business teams.

You will help defining the AI engineering strategy and roadmap, lead a high-performing AI Engineering team, build and manage scalable AI products, establish standards for scalable and secure AI delivery, and help translate AI investments into measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help to define and lead the execution of AI engineering strategy, target architecture, and roadmap for Generative and Agentic AI across the enterprise.

  • Work closely with business leaders to identify and prioritize high-value use cases across the insurance business, process optimization, software development, and employee productivity.
  • Define and track success metrics for adoption, quality, reliability, business impact, cost efficiency, and delivery velocity.
  • Stay current with emerging advancements in AI/ML, Generative AI, agentic frameworks, model architectures, and enterprise AI engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
    Graduate degrees are preferred, but not necessary.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, machine learning, or data science, with 2+ years in AI systems development.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including leading, mentoring, and scaling high-performing technical or AI/ML teams.
  • Proven experience delivering LLM-powered applications and AI/ML systems into production at enterprise scale.
  • Deep understanding of AI supporting infrastructure, security, testing, and monitoring/maintenance pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of Python, with hands-on experience with AI/ML-relevant packages and tools, such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, and Scikit-learn.
  • Deep experience with modern LLM ecosystems and tools, such as:
    • OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / open-source LLMs / other
    • Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
    • LangChain, LlamaIndex, Crewai, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Experience building RAG pipelines, working with vector databases, and integrating AI with enterprise data and application environments.
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs, MCP servers, scalable backend services, and AI platform components.
  • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, model evaluation, fine-tuning, and agent design and orchestration.
  • Experience with cloud-based AI infrastructure and modern software delivery practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
    Familiarity with SnowFlake is preferred.
  • Experience with MLOps / LLMOps, evaluation frameworks, observability, and continuous improvement for AI systems in production.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance, security, privacy, risk controls, and compliance in enterprise or regulated environments.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and communicating effectively with senior technology and business leaders.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with strategic leadership, organizational development, and execution discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) in a relevant field.
  • Experience building AI agents, agentic platforms, or autonomous workflows in production.
  • Experience leading senior engineers, or technical leads in a scaled engineering organization.
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, Frontier, or similar.
  • Experience with fine-tuning LLMs or parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA, or similar.
  • Experience with multi-modal AI, document processing, semantic search, knowledge assistants, and enterprise workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, and enterprise application environments.
  • Experience with vendor management, budgeting, and buy-vs-build evaluation for AI platforms and tooling.
  • Experience implementing responsible AI, governance frameworks, security, observability, and guardrails at scale.
  • Experience leading AI transformation initiatives across large, matrixed organizations.
  • Experience in the insurance industry, finance, or other regulated industries, with exposure to fraud detection, risk analysis, claims, underwriting, servicing customers, or document intelligence.

What We Offer

  • Leadership role building next-generation Generative and Agentic AI capabilities

  • Collaborative environment with technology, data, and business leaders

Impact

In this key role, you will shape how AI is engineered, governed, and scaled across the enterprise. You will help build an AI-first insurance company, leveraging Generative and Agentic AI to improve decision-making, streamline operations, accelerate service, and deliver better experiences for customers, business stake

title: Senior Backend Engineer (PostgreSQL & Integrations)
description:
What You’ll Do

Initial Priorities

Take technical ownership of the existing Airtable-based backend, developing a thorough understanding of its scripts, automations, integrations, credentials, dependencies, failure modes, production troubleshooting, and recovery procedures.

Operate, maintain, and continuously improve the production backend through automated testing, observability, logging, monitoring, deployment controls, rollback procedures, backup and recovery, performance optimization, security, and data integrity.

Maintain comprehensive technical documentation covering system architecture, dependencies, deployment procedures, and recovery processes to ensure knowledge is accessible and not concentrated in a single individual.

Assess and improve inherited systems while ensuring that changes are implemented safely without disrupting ongoing business operations.

Required Experience

PostgreSQL and Relational Database Engineering

Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, migrating, troubleshooting, and operating production PostgreSQL databases.

In-depth understanding of relational schema design, transactions, constraints, indexing, schema migrations, audit/history structures, query optimization, data integrity, database security, and backup/recovery procedures.

Demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and operating production backend systems using at least one modern server-side programming language.

Strong understanding of backend architecture, services, APIs, automated testing, deployment processes, production debugging, and maintainable software design.

APIs and Integration Engineering

Proven experience developing and maintaining reliable integrations across multiple systems using APIs and webhooks.

Strong understanding of authentication, retries, idempotency, synchronization, and failure-handling mechanisms, with the ability to diagnose issues across interconnected systems.

Data Migration and Reconciliation

  • Experience migrating critical production data between systems, including data transformation, source-to-target validation, reconciliation, parallel operations, cutover planning, and recovery from failed or partially completed migrations.

Production Ownership and Reliability

Experience operating and maintaining production systems, including observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, deployment management, rollback procedures, performance optimization, security, and recovery.

Ability to take end-to-end accountability for the reliability, stability, and operational performance of the backend systems under their ownership.

Legacy-System Takeover

Ability to take ownership of systems developed by other engineers, understand partially documented code and workflows, identify hidden dependencies, and distinguish intended functionality from defects or temporary workarounds.

Demonstrated ability to introduce changes to inherited systems safely while minimizing production risks and operational disruptions.

Technical Judgment

Ability to evaluate technical approaches, identify potential risks at an early stage, communicate implementation trade-offs clearly, and challenge proposed designs when justified by technical considerations.

Ability to provide realistic implementation estimates after evaluating requirements, dependencies, and technical constraints.

Comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools and workflows, including directing AI-generated development, independently reviewing and debugging generated code, validating tests, and ensuring production-level quality.

Ability to remain fully accountable for the reliability, security, and maintainability of AI-assisted implementations.

Strong working knowledge of Git, version control, automated testing, technical documentation, and disciplined production change management.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with Airtable.

Familiarity with Zapier and n8n automation platforms.

Experience with Xero or other accounting system integrations.

Familiarity with NocoDB.

Experience working with financial, payment, or transaction-processing systems.

Previous experience migrating Airtable or other low-code platforms to PostgreSQL.

title: Security Captain - Overnight
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for supervision and scheduling of on-site staff and the overall protection and safeguarding of property, persons and other assets on BAE Radford contract, located at the Radford Army Ammunition Plant. This is in person role involves supervising daily operations.

This position is midnight shift.

RESPONSIBILITES

  • Monitoring security patrols and ID Checks.
  • Supervising and monitoring activity on property to deter and prevent theft, sabotage, fire and accidents
  • Responding to calls for assistance.
  • Writing reports on accidents, various incidents, suspicious activities, safety and fire hazards and other security related situations.
  • Providing needed assistance to customers, residents, employees and visitors in accordance to company procedures
  • Serving as training officer to new security staff.
  • Train, coach, mentor and ensure implementation and adherence to current Standard Operating procedures and Post Orders, per company policy and best practices.
  • Monitor and resolve all log entries timely and efficiently, report to Regional Program Coordinator as needed,
  • Act as liaison between Security Officers and Client, and Corporate Office Departments.
  • Monitor, address, resolve and supervise payroll reporting, payroll discrepancies, timekeeping, post coverage, attrition, scheduling, requests for time off, and communicate with all appropriate departments by following proper channels and submitting forms for approval and processing.

  • Promote good client relations internally, externally and in daily interactions with outside vendors, contractors, service providers and representatives.
  • Act as role model, lead by example, encourage teamwork and cooperation.
  • Remain calm, cool and collected under any circumstance.
  • Handle conflict and resolve issues with tact and diplomacy.
  • Use caution and discretion when faced with a crisis situation.
  • Avoid physical confrontation at all times.
  • Seek assistance from management and/or law-enforcement personnel.
  • Use your best judgment and ensure the staff is trained, re-trained and follows post orders and SOP's at all times
  • Understand the relationship of the job to the work site mission and to other jobs within the work site.
  • Communicate with co-workers, Regional Program Coordinator and staff from other corporate departments to solve problems, improve quality, processes and services.
  • Identify and act on opportunities to help and support work efforts of co-workers and staff from other departments
  • Work in a manner that promotes / creates a positive work environment.
  • Help co-workers understand and implement changes within the work site.
  • Identify and develop ways to improve work processes, efficiencies and quality.
  • Improve job skills, knowledge, performance and education.
  • Attend in-service training and educational programs as directed.
  • Solve problems, work with change, and have a willingness to work extra shifts and/or overtime as needed
  • Perform all other related duties, as assigned.
  • May be subject to outdoor conditions including extreme temperatures and weather.
  • Subject to hazards including a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals.
  • May be subject to outdoor conditions including extreme temperatures and weather.
  • Subject to high noise levels.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time, often without breaks, and may be required to climb stairs or ladders and walk-up inclines and on uneven terrain.
  • Must meet all physical and psychological standards as required by the contract.
  • Travel may be required.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent, Military, Security or Law Enforcement training and/or experience, must be a US citizen. Must have an active security officer license or be able to obtain one in short fashion.
  • Must be proficient in a variety of firearms platforms (9mm pistol and shotgun)
  • Must have a good working knowledge of security operations and safety practices.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with staff, company and the public, to understand and follow standard operating procedures (SOP's), to perform duties in a professional manner and appearance, to write necessary incident reports, make various log entries, investigate incidents, make independent good judgment decisions within proper policy or procedure.
  • Minimum 5 years of supervisory experience and working knowledge of Post Orders, security operations standards and procedures and good understanding of schedules and schedule matrix, shift and payroll operations, 24/7 operations, as well as exceptional people skills, communications skills, diplomacy and tact.

BENEFITS

Constellis offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflect its commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

title: Field Auto Damage Appraiser
description:
The Field Auto Damage Appraiser is responsible for preparing physical damage estimates on vehicles where a claim has been submitted for first- or third-party damages. This role requires delivering a high level of customer service while effectively managing claim severity and expenses.

This position supports the Independent Agent business of Plymouth Rock and services a Northern and/or parts of Central New Jersey territory. The appraiser works independently in the field inspecting damaged vehicles, preparing estimates, negotiating settlements, and ensuring compliance with company guidelines and applicable state regulations.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Inspect vehicle damage and prepare repair estimates for partial and total losses within assigned authority levels.
  • Negotiate settlements with repair facilities, insureds, and claimants.
  • Issue claim drafts to appropriate parties.
  • Document claim activity and maintain accurate claim files.
  • Complete re-inspections and supplemental estimates in accordance with company guidelines.
  • Adhere to production standards and estimating procedures.
  • Maintain strong customer service, expense control, and professional public relations.
  • Complete investigative reports as required.
  • Participate in team meetings and departmental initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy standards and the NJ Fair Claims Practices Act.
  • Assist with catastrophe claim handling when requested, which may include overnight travel or extended assignments, or assisting in neighboring territories.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable industry experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of auto claims appraisal or estimating experience required.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Valid driver’s license with favorable driving record required.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude.
  • Organized and able to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Body shop experience a plus but not required.
  • ICAR training a plus.
  • Experience with Mitchell estimating software preferred.
  • Additional state appraiser licenses may be required (NY, PA, etc.)


SALARY RANGE

The pay range for this position is $64,000 to $86,000 annually. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including employee knowledge and experience, role scope, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.​

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • 4 weeks accrued paid time off, 8 paid national holidays per year, and 2 floating holidays
  • Low cost and excellent coverage health insurance options that start on Day 1 (medical, dental, vision)
  • Annual 401(k) Employer Contribution
  • Resources to promote Professional Development (LinkedIn Learning and licensure assistance)
  • Robust health and wellness program and fitness reimbursements
  • Various Paid Family leave options including Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Reimbursement


ABOUT THE COMPANY

The Plymouth Rock Company and its affiliated group of companies write and manage over $2 billion in personal and commercial auto and homeowner’s insurance throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, where we have built an unparalleled reputation for service. We continuously invest in technology, our employees thrive in our empowering environment, and our customers are among the most loyal in the industry. The Plymouth Rock group of companies employs more than 1,900 people and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Plymouth Rock Assurance Corporation holds an A.M. Best rating of “A-/Excellent”.

description:

title: Senior Desktop Support Analyst
description:
Senior Desktop Support Analyst

The Senior Desktop Support Analyst supports the IT team by providing tier 2/3 support in managing, maintaining, and securing an organization's endpoints, such as laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.   • Assist with onboarding/offboarding processes, ensuring timely provisioning and deprovisioning of devices. Support video conferencing systems and remote access tools.

Qualifications:

  • Must have strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication, ability to work independently and in a team, and eagerness to learn new technologies.
  • Basic understanding of networking and video conferencing technologies.
  • Preferred qualifications include experience with endpoint management tools such Jamf, and familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell or Python, information technology service management and basic knowledge of networking and video conference support.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience) is required. ITIL certification and experience in IT support or a similar endpoint support role is also beneficial.

Perks and Benefits

The Plymouth Rock Company and its affiliated group of companies write and manage over $2 billion in personal and commercial auto and homeowner’s insurance throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, where we have built an unparalleled reputation for service. title: Anatomy Lab JR Specialist
description:
Tecnico Junior Anatomy Lab

📍 Sede di lavoro: Via Rita Levi Montalcini 4, 20072, Pieve Emanuele (MI)

📄 Tipologia contrattuale: Contratto a Tempo Determinato

Perché Humanitas

Scegliere Humanitas significa entrare in un contesto in cui la qualità della cura si costruisce ogni giorno attraverso competenza clinica, innovazione e lavoro di squadra dove ciascuno contribuisce al percorso di cura dei pazienti.

Chi siamo

Humanitas University è un Ateneo internazionale dedicato alle Life Sciences, strettamente integrato con l’IRCCS Humanitas Research Hospital e con la rete ospedaliera Humanitas. L’Università unisce formazione, ricerca e attività clinica in un contesto fortemente internazionale. I corsi di Medicine and Surgery e MEDTEC School sono erogati interamente in lingua inglese e l’Ateneo ospita oggi oltre 3.000 studenti, con una quota di studenti internazionali pari al 43% nel corso di laurea in Medicina. Le attività didattiche si svolgono in un Campus moderno e sostenibile di 35.000 mq, progettato per favorire l’interazione tra studenti, ricercatori e docenti, con strutture come l’Anatomy Lab e il Simulation Center – unico centro in Italia a possedere la full accreditation della European Society for Simulation in Medicine per l’eccellenza nella formazione sanitaria basata sulla simulazione.

Il contesto

Per il potenziamento dell'Anatomy Lab di Humanitas University, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Tecnico Junior Anatomy Lab che supporterà la gestione operativa, tecnica e logistica delle attività di formazione, ricerca e studio svolte all'interno del laboratorio.

Principali responsabilità

La risorsa contribuirà al corretto funzionamento dell'Anatomy Lab, garantendo la gestione dei preparati anatomici, delle attrezzature e degli spazi nel rispetto delle procedure operative e di sicurezza.

Gestione dei preparati anatomici (human specimens)

  • Ricezione, movimentazione, stoccaggio e conservazione di preparati anatomici e salme all'interno delle celle dedicate;
  • registrazione, archiviazione e monitoraggio degli specimens tramite il gestionale Humanitas University;
  • preparazione e predisposizione dei preparati in funzione delle attività programmate;
  • gestione delle procedure di ricovero, riutilizzo e smaltimento degli specimens.

Gestione operativa dell'Anatomy Lab e supporto alle attività

  • Allestimento e disallestimento dell'Anatomy Lab e delle postazioni di lavoro;
  • supervisione del rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza del laboratorio;
  • supporto tecnico durante attività formative, scientifiche e di ricerca;
  • assistenza nell'utilizzo delle apparecchiature, delle tecnologie e degli impianti audiovisivi (A/V);
  • presidio operativo durante eventi e attività programmate;
  • pulizia, disinfezione e sterilizzazione degli ambienti, delle postazioni di lavoro e della strumentazione chirurgica di Humanitas University e delle aziende partner.

Gestione delle attrezzature, dei materiali e dei fornitori

  • Monitoraggio delle giacenze e gestione delle scorte di materiali di consumo;
  • pianificazione e gestione degli ordini;
  • supporto all'approvvigionamento e alla manutenzione delle dotazioni tecniche del laboratorio;
  • gestione dei rapporti con fornitori e Tissue Banks, inclusa la richiesta di preventivi e il supporto ai processi di acquisto.

La persona che cerchiamo è in possesso dei seguenti requisiti:

  • Laurea o titolo di studio in discipline STEM, preferibilmente in ambito biologico, biotecnologico o delle tecniche di laboratorio;
  • ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata;
  • buone capacità relazionali e comunicative;
  • attitudine al lavoro in team;
  • proattività e orientamento al risultato;
  • capacità analitiche e di problem solving;
  • precisione, affidabilità e riservatezza.

Cosa offriamo

Per questa posizione è prevista una retribuzione fissa compresa in un range tra €24.000 - €27.000 lordi annui.

Lavorare in Humanitas significa contribuire a un futuro in cui cura, benessere e professionalità crescono insieme. Per questo motivo offriamo:

  • un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica;
  • strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria;
  • percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo.

L'offerta è rivolta a candidati nel rispetto del Dlgs 198/2006 e dei Dlgs 215/2003 e 216/2003.

title: Engagement Ambassador
description:
Engagement Ambassador

Part-Time | Remote

About the Role

Do you have a way with words and an eye for the details others sometimes miss? We’re looking for strong writers to join our team as part-time Engagement Ambassadors, responding to hotel guest reviews on behalf of our hospitality clients.

This role is about more than writing a grammatically correct response. It requires reading carefully, understanding what a guest is really communicating, and responding in a way that feels natural, thoughtful, and appropriate. One review may be a simple compliment, while another may include several concerns or require a more thoughtful approach. The ability to recognize those differences and reflect them in your writing is an important part of the job.

We’ll train you on our responding approach, the hotels you support, and the guidelines, technology, and resources you’ll use. You’ll bring strong writing and comprehension skills, attention to detail, a service-oriented mindset, and a willingness to learn and adapt.

What You’ll Do

  • Read and respond to hotel guest reviews with thoughtful, polished, and natural-sounding responses.
  • Understand the context and key points of each review so your response is relevant to what the guest actually shared.
  • Learn and consistently apply the responding guidelines, preferences, and information provided for the hotels you support.
  • Adapt your writing to different situations while maintaining a professional, conversational style.
  • Pay close attention to details and ensure your work is accurate, grammatically correct, and complete.
  • Use technology and AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to support your work while applying your own writing and comprehension skills.
  • Work independently, manage your assigned workload, and maintain consistent quality and productivity.
  • Use feedback and coaching to continue developing your writing and responding skills.

What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written English, with a strong command of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and sentence structure.

  • Strong reading comprehension and the ability to pick up on context, nuance, and important details in written feedback.

  • The ability to write naturally and conversationally without sounding generic, repetitive, or overly scripted.

  • Natural empathy and a genuine interest in helping others and creating thoughtful, positive interactions.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions accurately and consistently.

  • The ability to learn different client preferences and apply what you’ve learned to your work.

  • Comfortable learning and using technology, including AI-assisted tools, and able to use them thoughtfully while applying your own writing and comprehension skills.

  • Adaptable and open to change, with the ability to learn new approaches, tools, and guidelines as the needs of our clients and industry evolve.

  • Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • A positive approach to coaching and feedback and the ability to incorporate it into future work.

  • Candidates will be asked to complete a writing assessment as part of the selection process.

Experience

Previous experience in writing, editing, communications, hospitality, guest relations, customer service, or a related field is helpful, but not required.

More important is a genuine service-oriented mindset. We’re looking for people who naturally care about helping others, bring empathy to their communication, and understand that hospitality is about how you make people feel. Strong writing and comprehension skills, along with the ability to learn and apply our client-focused approach, are essential.

Schedule & Remote Work

This is a part-time, work-from-home position with flexibility that can work well for someone looking to add meaningful part-time work to their schedule.

Because we support hotels every day of the year, weekend and holiday availability may be required based on coverage needs.

You’ll need reliable internet access, a suitable work-from-home environment, and the ability to work independently and stay focused during your scheduled hours.

If you enjoy writing, have a natural service mindset, notice the small details that can change the meaning of a message, and are comfortable learning new ways of working as technology and the hospitality industry evolve, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Assistant Site Automation Lead
description:
Onsite | Plymouth Meeting, PA
Full-Time, Salaried | $52k - $55k + Equity
Preference given to candidates with open schedule and on-call availability

Fulfil is redefining the grocery supply chain through advanced robotics and automation. Backed by world-class investors and led by a seasoned team, we are hiring a Site Automation Lead to provide operational coverage for our automated high speed grocery fulfillment system. In this role, you’ll serve as the bridge between partner operations, maintenance, and Fulfil engineering — ensuring safe, reliable, high-performance system operation.

What You’ll Do

System Monitoring & First-Level Diagnostics

  • Monitor daytime performance and conduct health checks of Fulfil’s robotic automation systems
  • Perform Tier-1 troubleshooting; triage issues, complete minor interventions (e.g., sensor checks, part swaps, clearing obstructions), and support investigations and post-mortems.
  • Support maintenance by documenting issues clearly and handing off higher-complexity work.

Operational Leadership

  • Act as the on-call technical and operational escalation point for partner teams.
  • Make real-time decisions that balance system uptime, safety, and production needs.
  • Track and report reliability metrics to contribute toward achieving uptime goals.
  • Ensure a safe operating environment through routine audits and adherence to procedures.
  • Provide the second level of escalation, ability to step into the Site Lead Position if needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Communicate system behaviors and findings to robotics, firmware, software, and product engineering teams.
  • Participate in structured testing, validation, and rollout of new features and hardware.
  • Contribute to root-cause investigations and provide actionable feedback to engineering.
  • Help refine operating procedures and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Partner Support & Training

  • Provide steady, high-confidence technical support to onsite partner operators.
  • Train partner team members on best practices for system interaction, recoveries, and safety.
  • Ensure partners feel supported, informed, and empowered in daily operations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in robotics, automation, industrial equipment, technical field support, or similar environments.
  • Strong mechanical/electrical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with hardware.
  • Safety first mentality, adhering to OSHA guidelines while prioritizing a safe work environment.
  • Clear communicator with ability to explain complex system behavior simply.
  • Calm, detail-oriented decision-maker who performs well under pressure.
  • Comfortable using dashboards, logs, and diagnostic tools.
  • Reliable, self-motivated, and able to operate with a high degree of ownership.
  • Flexible schedule — preference for candidates with open availability.

Bonus Experience (Not Required)

  • Exposure to warehouse automation, robotics platforms, PLCs, or industrial systems.
  • Familiarity with Linux, telemetry tools, firmware process flows, or diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting deployments, pilots, commissioning, or on-call rotations.
  • Experience with tools like Slack, Jira, Excel, or digital workflow platforms.

What You’ll Get

  • Early-stage exposure to a fast-scaling robotics company.
  • Salary + equity in a mission-driven organization.
  • Full medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.
  • A supportive, high-ownership operational culture.
  • Opportunities to work closely with engineering and help shape a live automation system.

title: Senior Solution Engineer - North America
description:

title: K-9 Handler
location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Protective Force (PF) Explosives Detection Team (EDT) program exists to detect and thereby deter the introduction of explosives devices into the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Headquarters (HQ) facilities. This critical program uses a graded security systems approach to address potential explosive threats deemed to be credible as determined by a Security Risk Assessment (SRA) of covered facilities. Program elements will be developed and implemented as required to address applicable threat conditions as they develop or change over the course of time.

Explosive threats include both actual physical attempts to introduce an explosive device and communicated threats such as bomb threats to the facilities. Bomb threats cause significant disruption to DOE operations and pose an unacceptable danger to government employees, contractor employees, and visitors and therefore should be resolved as quickly and orderly as possible.

Explosive detection team will be deployed to assist emergency response management to search and clear areas, vehicles, and items determined to be potential explosive threats. EDTs are often utilized to clear designated meeting locations, venues, and adjacent facilities prior to the arrival of certain dignitaries as determined by the Secretary of Energy or their designee. EDTs are a proven reliable resource to detect explosives. Visible deployment of highly trained explosives detection canine teams in view of the public is also a proven deterrent to potential terrorist actions directed towards DOE HQ and provides a timely and mobile response to support its facilities during emergency events.

Pay Transparency:

Pay Rate: $44.58/hr.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Explosive detection team operations will be integrated into the daily operations of the PF at the Forrestal and Germantown facilities.
  • Explosive detection team handlers will take their operational direction from the Canine Lieutenant and / or the Shift Lieutenant.
  • The Canine Program Manager will be responsible for providing programmatic direction and control of the explosive detective team program. These requirements are further detailed in the following sections of this procedure.
  • Applicant must have graduated from an accredited explosive detection training and certification.
  • The applicant and canine must be trained to meet the Department of Treasury Odor Recognition Standard for Explosive Detection Canines.
  • Applicant must meet and maintain DOE Security Police Officer I standards as defined by 10 CFR 1046 and DOE Orders and Directives.
  • Applicant must successfully complete or must have completed a DOE approved, or equivalent, Supervisor Development Course.
  • Applicant must be knowledgeable of and ensure canine’s training and well-being is maintained through an established quality assurance program and proper veterinarian care.
  • Applicant’s residence and its environment must be suitable to kennel the canine.
  • Applicant must demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively both in oral and written.
  • Applicant must possess working knowledge of the protection of classified information, facilities, property and other assets.
  • Applicant must successfully complete or must have completed a DOE approved, or equivalent, Supervisor Development Course.
  • May be required to lift and carry awkward items weighing up to 70 lbs. Requires intermittent standing, walking, sitting, squatting, stretching, and bending throughout the workday.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Applicant must possess a high school diploma, or its state recognize.
  • Experience: Applicant must have a minimum of two (2) years of certifiable training and experience as a canine explosive detection team handler.
  • Clearance: At a minimum, the individual proposed must possess a DOE (Q) security clearance or must meet the eligibility requirements that will reasonably ensure a DOE (Q) clearance is obtained and must retain the clearance while assigned as a canine explosive detection team.

title: Process Improvement Analyst
description:
You will be assigned specific processes and improvement projects as the named owner, not just an analyst supporting someone else's initiative. That means you run the project plan, chase the open items, keep stakeholders aligned, and are the person people come to when they need a status update or a decision made. A typical assignment might be owning a discrete workstream inside a larger modernization effort, or owning an entire process end to end for a defined line of business or workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Map current-state claims processes (people, systems, hand-offs, decision points) and produce clear, accurate process documentation where none currently exists
  • Identify process breakdowns, redundant steps, and unclear ownership, and translate findings into a prioritized improvement backlog
  • Take direct ownership of assigned improvement projects: build the project plan, track milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and report status to Ksenia and other stakeholders
  • Partner with claims operations leaders, IT, and vendors (e.g., ClaimsPro, ImageRight, Dispatch Tool, and similar systems) to scope and sequence changes
  • Run working sessions and interviews with adjusters and supervisors to validate how work actually happens versus how it's assumed to happen
  • Build simple, durable artifacts — process maps, RACI charts, project trackers — that outlive the specific project and become the team's institutional record of how a process works and who owns it
  • Flag risks, resourcing gaps, or scope issues early rather than letting them surface at a deadline

What Success Looks Like

Six months in, you should be the clear, named owner of at least one meaningful process or project — able to explain in five minutes what the current state is, what's changing, who's accountable for what, and what's blocking progress. Leadership should be able to ask you for a status update at any time and get a straight answer without you needing to go find out first.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in process improvement, project management, business analysis, or claims operations, ideally in P&C insurance
  • Demonstrated ability to map a messy, undocumented process and turn it into something clear and actionable
  • Comfortable owning a project independently — driving it forward without needing to be told the next step
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to run a working session and produce documentation stakeholders will actually read
  • Working familiarity with claims systems and workflows, or a fast learner who can pick up domain-specific tools quickly
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when a gap is a real risk versus noise

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

title: Sr Subcontracts Admin
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Position is responsible for preparing, reviewing, issuing and monitoring proposal documents; reviewing and evaluating bid proposals; preparing, reviewing and issuing subcontract and purchasing documents; and monitoring the performance of subcontractors and suppliers/vendors. Additional duties may include developing, implementing and reviewing subcontracting plans for pre-award, post-award and conducting cost/price analysis.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review Work Package Specifications received, generate proposal/bid packages consisting of RFP's and RFQ's, fairly and openly solicit bids from both large and small subcontractors, coordinate small business bids with SBLO, analyze subcontractor proposals, and provide fact-supported subcontractor recommendations for management review and approval.
  • Coordination of Non-Disclosure Agreements, Teaming Agreements and subcontractor due diligence with compliance and Business Development.
  • Develop subcontract agreements and modifications of moderate complexity in accord with management guidelines. Ensure that all required terms and conditions, statements of work, performance requirements and prime contract flow downs are incorporated into the subcontract agreements.
  • Participate in the development and documentation of the vendor database, participate in regular supplier reviews and ratings, and vet vendors for inclusion in the approved vendor/subcontractor database.

  • Negotiate and generate purchase orders for subcontract materials and/or services. Ensure all subcontractor qualification requirements are met prior to award, including insurance, security clearance, nondisclosure agreements and applicable small business submissions.

  • Work with program and field personnel to schedule deliveries, confirm subcontractor performance and verify completion of prescribed segments of work prior to payment.
  • Work with internal program and field personnel to resolve subcontract issues and maintain open lines of communication with subcontractors.
  • Maintain all contractual documents, files, correspondence, meeting minutes and other appropriate and applicable documents. Convey documentation of solicitation and quotes to SBLO as required confirming compliance with small business requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Five years of responsible technical and/or professional experience in subcontract administration, procurement, contracts, program management, accounting, or comparable required.

  • Experience with GSA schedules a plus.
  • Experience with Costpoint strongly preferred.
  • Experience in personnel management preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency with MS Office required.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills with all levels of the organization. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage time and multiple priorities to completion.

Constellis offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects its commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Work is typically based in a busy office environment and subject to frequent interruptions. Business work hours are Monday-Friday standard core hours, however some extended or weekend hours may be required.
