  • Develop and implement strategies and plans that align with the organization's IT objectives and business goals.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and team performance.
  • Continuously gather and utilize user feedback to guide improvements.
  • Report performance insights and recommendations to management and other key decision-makers.
Technology and Innovation
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in management to drive innovation and efficiency within the teams.
  • Utilize IT service management (ITSM) tools such as JSM, Jira, and Confluence to streamline operations, including ticketing systems, knowledge bases, and self-service portals.
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact users by leveraging enterprise diagnostic and monitoring tools like Dynatrace and Q-Radar.
  • Work with engineering teams to develop automated escalation and remediation solutions.
  • Implement automation and self-service solutions to streamline processes and enable users to resolve issues independently.
  • Develop and implement accessible knowledge bases and self-service portals to facilitate easy access to information and support for users.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, technologies, and processes that enhance team capabilities and improve user experience.
  • Research and integrate artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) tools for automated ticket routing, issue prediction, and chatbots.
  • Ensure teams are prepared to support new technologies adopted by the organization.
Service Management
  • Ensure teams deliver timely and effective support to resolve user issues and requests, adhering to SLAs and quality standards.
  • Implement and maintain ITIL-based processes for incident management, request fulfillment, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
  • Analyze data and statistics to identify user behavior trends, identify knowledge gaps, and optimize service desk processes.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Act as the liaison between the IT department and end-users, ensuring effective communication and fostering positive relationships.
  • Collaborate with IT and business leaders to identify service improvement opportunities and integrate user feedback into service enhancement initiatives.
  • Conduct regular service reviews with key stakeholders to report on performance, discuss issues, and plan future service improvements.
ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS
Reports directly to the Director, Workplace Technology Management and Lifecycle. Works closely with all technology and digital leaders and collaborates with business partners on planning, execution, and management of company initiatives. Directly manages the IT Support Center team members.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Knowledge
  • In-depth knowledge of ITIL frameworks for incident, problem, change, and service request management.
  • In-depth knowledge of ITSM principles and best practices.
  • Proficient in ITSM tools and technologies, with a focus on automation and process optimization.
  • Understanding of key IT infrastructure and components, including hardware, software, networks, operating systems, and related technologies relevant to the organization's environment.
  • Familiarity with common user applications and tools, including commercial and custom-developed software used by corporate and field employees.
  • Understanding of data and analytics tools to measure service desk performance, identify trends, and improve effectiveness and efficiency.
Skills and Abilities
  • Strong leadership and team management skills: motivate and develop staff, delegate tasks, provide feedback, and foster collaboration.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking abilities: troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve user issues efficiently and effectively with sound analytical and logical thinking.
  • Interpersonal skills: cultivate relationships with internal and external customers and work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project management: plan, execute, and monitor projects related to service desk improvement or implementation of new technologies.
  • Change management: lead through transitions and effectively communicate change to stakeholders.
  • Communication: effectively communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Decision-making: analyze information, weigh options, and make sound decisions that benefit the team and the organization.
  • Incident and request management: follow established processes for logging, prioritizing, and resolving user issues and requests.
  • Time management: manage multiple tasks effectively, meet deadlines, and prioritize work based on urgency and impact.
  • Continuous learning: stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in IT service management.
  • Adaptability and resilience: navigating change under pressure in unforeseen circumstances while maintaining composure and finding solutions.
Education/Certifications
Minimum
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Preferred
  • ITIL Foundation or Intermediate certificate.
Desirable
  • Advanced ITIL or other ITSM certifications.
  • CompTIA A+ certification
  • HDI Support Center certification
  • Project management certifications like PMP or CAPM.
Work Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in IT service management, with at least 5 years in a supervisory or management role within an IT service desk environment.
  • Physical Demands / Environmental Conditions
  • Typical office and remote work environments.
  • Frequent work outside of typical business hours.
Travel Requirement
  • Occasional travel required (20% or less).
Disclaimers
DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by incumbents assigned to this job. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the responsibilities, duties and skills required. The incumbent may be expected to perform other duties as assigned. This job may be reviewed as duties and responsibilities change with business necessity.
COMPLIANCE & INTEGRITY: Consistently supports compliance and Workplace Conduct by maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of information, protecting the assets of the organization, acting with ethics and integrity, reporting non-compliance, and adhering to applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations, accreditation and licensure requirements (if applicable), and 24 Hour Fitness' policies and procedures.
All Directors, Managers and Supervisors are accountable for communication, implementation, enforcement, monitoring and oversight of compliance policies and practices in their departments.
SERVICE & QUALITY: In addition to defined technical requirements, accountable for consistently demonstrating service behaviors and principles defined by 24 Hour Fitness as well as specific departmental/organizational initiatives. Also accountable for consistently demonstrating the knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviors necessary to provide superior and culturally sensitive service to member and team members, contracted providers and vendors.
WORKPLACE SAFETY: In addition to defined working conditions and physical requirements, employees are accountable for working safely; following established policies & procedures; and reporting all injuries and hazards to their supervisor immediately.
Supervisors and Managers are accountable for ensuring the safety performance of employees; applying consistent practices in compliance with federal, state and local regulations; providing guidance to maintain a safe and healthy work environment.

title: Managing Director, Berkeley
description:
About Activate

Activate is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to turning scientific discoveries into real-world impact. Through partnerships with government, philanthropy, universities, and industry, Activate builds the cross-sector ecosystem that drives hard tech innovation—equipping scientists and engineers with world-class resources, training, and community to bring their work from discovery to deployment.

Since 2015, Activate's flagship fellowship has supported nearly 350 fellows across the United States, who have launched more than 275 companies and secured over $5.5 billion in follow-on funding. Now expanding beyond its flagship program, Activate is reaching scientists and engineers at more stages of their entrepreneurial journey across the world—multiplying the pathways from innovation to commercialization. Learn more at.

Position Summary

Activate is looking for a Managing Director to mentor a community of Activate Fellows in Berkeley by serving as their primary entrepreneurial advisor.

In this role, you will drive key fellow outcomes through individual mentorship, lead the selection of new fellows each year, and connect your community of fellows with resources, support, and each other to enable their entrepreneurial success.

This role will be responsible for representing the Berkeley fellow community to the larger Activate Global team and to external stakeholders across academia, industry, the investor community, and government. You will work closely with the Cyclotron Road team at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. The Managing Director will report to Activate’s US Fellowship Leader. Join us as we work to create the world’s leading platform supporting early-stage science entrepreneurship!

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as Managing Director and primary advisor for a cross-disciplinary community of entrepreneurial fellows.
  • Drive successful outcomes for each individual fellow, providing mentorship, support, network connectivity, and resources.
  • Oversee selection of fellows.
  • Support bi-weekly in-person and virtual educational programming.
  • Manage our partnership with Berkeley Lab and the Cyclotron Road program.
  • Build and maintain relationships with universities, research institutions, and other talent pipelines to attract strong applicants to future fellowship cohorts.
  • Lead ecosystem engagement efforts for the Berkeley region, including strengthening relationships with key innovation partners and supporting visibility for Activate and its fellows.
  • Build collaborative, cross-functional relationships with staff and partners to ensure the program operates effectively and efficiently.
  • Represent Activate at an executive level with public- and private-sector stakeholders from across the technology innovation ecosystem.
  • Engage with current and potential government and philanthropic sponsors.
  • Partner with Berkeley’s Fellowship Manager to provide best-in-class support to the fellows.
  • Support and strengthen engagement with local alumni.

The Ideal Candidate...

  • Has an advanced degree in the physical or biological sciences and a minimum of 10 years experience in research, development, management, and commercialization of science-driven technologies.
  • Has entrepreneurial experience as the leader of a new company or business unit.
  • Has led high-performance technical teams and has demonstrated a commitment to nurturing talent through mentorship.
  • Has a strong network and reputation among stakeholders from across the innovation ecosystem (academia, industry, finance, and government) and in the Berkeley area.
  • Strongly exhibits objectivity, empathy, and inclusiveness in leadership.
  • Is an excellent communicator and collaborator.
  • Can manage a complex, dynamic portfolio of projects and stakeholders.
  • Believes that groundbreaking science has the power to change the world—but only if it reaches the people and places that need it most.
  • Can support a broad range of finance and business models for advancing hard-tech to market.
  • Would be excited to wake up each day asking the question, “what can I do to make our fellows successful?”

About the Role

This is a full-time position with a competitive starting base of $215,000 with a generous benefits package that includes professional development, $2,000 in annual wellness funds, flexible paid time off, healthcare coverage for employees and dependents, with 90–100% of premiums covered, and the opportunity to join a retirement plan with a 3% match beginning after 3 months at Activate.

This position is based in Berkeley, CA. Because we operate an in-person community, our team typically works from the office at least part of each day.

Encouraging Applications from All Backgrounds

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a welcoming workplace for all employees. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Activate Global, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Community Outreach and Member Specialist
description:
ABOUT US
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym--we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

JOB SUMMARY
The Community Outreach & Membership Specialist is responsible for generating qualified leads, increasing guest traffic, and converting prospects into members through community outreach, local partnerships, networking, and lead generation efforts. The ideal candidate is outgoing, enjoys connecting with people, and is enthusiastic about promoting the 24 Hour Fitness brand in the community.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Generate Traffic
  • Execute monthly outreach and corporate account plans focused on generating new business, renewing existing relationships, and increasing guest traffic.
  • Prospect, collect, and cultivate quality leads through community outreach, networking, sponsorships, referrals, and strategic relationship building.
  • Create and maintain a pipeline of onsite activations, tabling events, and community engagement opportunities designed to introduce prospective members to our clubs.
  • Develop relationships with local businesses, employers, healthcare organizations, schools, and community groups that drive guest visits and membership opportunities.
  • Partner with club sales teams to maximize lead collection opportunities and support guest acquisition efforts both inside and outside the club.
  • Conduct timely follow-up with leads generated through outreach activities, sponsorships, corporate accounts, events, referrals, and community partnerships.
  • Convert leads into memberships, sponsorship opportunities, fitness consultations, and guest visits.
  • Coordinate and execute onsite sponsor activations that generate qualified leads, membership opportunities, and increased club awareness.
  • Re-engage former corporate accounts and renew existing relationships to drive ongoing membership growth.
  • Schedule tours, appointments, and consultations that move prospects through the sales process.
  • Represent the club at community events, fairs, conventions, wellness expos, UH games, college days, school events, and other high-visibility gatherings.
  • Develop creative community engagement initiatives such as first responder challenges, fitness competitions, stretching and recovery booths at races, community wellness events, and sponsored fun runs.
  • Support special events, membership campaigns, grand openings, block parties, and other club initiatives designed to drive traffic and membership growth.
Success in This Role
Success will be measured by:
  • Guest traffic generated
  • Qualified leads created
  • Membership sales converted
  • Contribution to club membership, revenue, and market growth goals
  • Effective use of outreach, referral, and promotional campaigns to drive membership activity and trackable results
Performance-Based Compensation
In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for variable compensation based on individual performance and contribution to club growth, including:
  • 15% commission on new memberships, Paid-in-Full (PIF) memberships, and premium membership upgrades
  • 10% commission on fitness service agreements
  • Additional incentive opportunities tied to market growth initiatives and membership sales generated through assigned promotional, referral, and outreach codes
  • Variable compensation is designed to reward lead generation, membership conversion, revenue growth, and measurable impact within the local market
Note: We regularly review our variable compensation programs to support business growth and recognize employee contributions. Commission rates, incentive opportunities, and program details may change periodically based on business needs and company objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS
Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  • 1+ years of experience in sales, lead generation, business development, membership sales, community outreach, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Proven ability to generate leads through networking, prospecting, events, and relationship building.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Comfortable working in the community and representing the brand at events and networking opportunities.
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives while maintaining a focus on sales results.
  • Passion for health, fitness, wellness, and community engagement.
Physical Demands/ Environmental Conditions
  • Works in both an office and club environment; must have the ability to travel and move from club to club as needed.
  • Occasional lifting, set-up and take-down for outside events.
Travel Requirement
  • Up to 50% travel within the local market.
BENEFITS AT 24
In line with our mission to create a healthier, happier world, we offer comprehensive benefits to help our team members do just that. We offer benefits such as paid time off, medical and dental coverage, 401k with match for qualifying positions, a free gym membership, and discounts on products and personal training. We also have a variety of Employee Resource Groups that you can connect with to participate in community events both in-person and virtually.

Disclaimer

This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the qualifications, responsibilities, duties, and skills required. 24 Hour Fitness reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

title: Associate Commercial Auto Product Manager
description:
The Associate Product Manager, Commercial Auto, Underwriting Strategy & Analytics will help shape, scale and profitably grow our Commercial Auto product and support our Personal Lines underwriting strategy. You will analyze product performance, develop recommendations, and manage defined projects that support the development and profitability of our Commercial Auto insurance product. You will also help develop, implement and refine underwriting initiatives that optimize performance, manage risk, and support the profitable growth of our Personal Auto, Motorcycle, and Umbrella products.

The Associate Product Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams including Underwriting, Actuarial, Product Management, Marketing, Claims, Legal and IT to execute initiatives that deliver sustained profitable growth. Key responsibilities include analyzing and improving product offerings and underwriting capabilities, with a focus on data-driven problem solving and an understanding of the competitive and regulatory environment. You will independently own assigned analyses and projects, with guidance on broader strategy and complex decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Manage defined Commercial Auto product projects, including analysis, recommendations, implementation coordination, and performance monitoring.
  • Support the development and execution of underwriting strategies that balance risk management, customer experience, and growth objectives.
  • Work with Underwriting Operations and Product Management to identify opportunities to improve profitable growth and modernize our underwriting approach.
  • Support business planning through analysis, recommendations, and execution of assigned initiatives to achieve profit and growth objectives.
  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and gaps.
  • Analyze and recommend product enhancements, pricing changes, and coverage options that align with customer needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with Underwriting to evaluate our Commercial Auto appetite, monitor underwriting performance, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Work with Underwriting and Actuarial teams to analyze pricing adequacy and apply data insights and predictive model results to product and underwriting decisions.
  • Monitor product performance metrics, investigate trends and gaps, and develop recommendations to address opportunities.
  • Coordinate assigned implementation activities and post-implementation monitoring for underwriting technology tools, capabilities, and automation initiatives.
  • Assist with state-specific regulatory filings and work with Legal and Compliance to support compliance with applicable requirements. Monitor competitive, legislative, and regulatory developments and summarize potential business impacts.
  • Analyze new and existing third-party data sources for Commercial & Personal Auto underwriting, evaluating data quality, predictive value, cost, and implementation requirements to support recommendations.
  • Work with Advanced Analytics to evaluate and implement predictive capabilities that improve risk selection, identify potential misrepresentation, and support more targeted underwriting.
  • Analyze underwriting rules across Commercial & Personal Auto and recommend refinements, measuring their impact on profitability, referral volume, and customer and agent experience.
  • Independently manage assigned projects and analyses, coordinate with business partners, and present findings and recommendations to management.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Insurance, Finance, or other quantitative field of study; an advanced degree or insurance designation (e.g. CPCU) is a plus.
  • 4+ years of experience in P&C insurance product management, underwriting, or a related analytical role.
  • Experience with the broader Small Commercial product suite, including Business Owners Policies (BOP), General Liability (GL), and Commercial Package Policies (CPP), is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of insurance pricing and underwriting principles; familiarity with rate/form filing processes and regulatory requirements is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, investigate business issues, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned business issues, exercise sound judgment, and see projects through to resolution while seeking guidance when appropriate.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business partners, coordinate project activities, and follow through on commitments.
  • Ability to clearly explain analyses and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • SQL and Python experience required

Salary Range:​

The pay range for this position is $123K to $164K annually. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including employee knowledge and experience, role scope, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.​

​

Benefits & Perks:​

  • Paid time off
  • Free onsite gym at our Boston location​
  • Tuition reimbursement ​
  • Low cost and excellent health insurance coverage options that start on Day 1 (medical, dental, vision)​
  • Robust health and wellness programs

  • Matching donation opportunities​
  • Annual 401(k) employer contribution
  • Various Paid Family leave options including Paid Parental Leave​
  • Resources to promote professional development

The Plymouth Rock Company and its affiliated group of companies write and manage over $2.2 billion in personal and commercial auto and homeowner’s insurance throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, where we have built an unparalleled reputation for service. We continuously invest in technology, our employees thrive in our empowering environment, and our customers are among the most loyal in the industry. May be required to work extended hours in support of mission requirements, contingency operations, or emergency situations.

title: SIU Investigator
description:
The SIU Investigator is responsible for the accurate detection and in-depth investigation of potentially fraudulent insurance activity, ranging from complex medical and staged accident claims and auto property matters to simpler application fraud issues. Investigative activities will include in-person interviews and recorded statements. Prepares and presents reports of impartial results to management for decision-making. Performs field work and coordinates efforts with industry fraud units, claim personnel, counsel, law enforcement and agencies. May provide evidence and testimony in cases where law enforcement agencies pursue prosecution. May conduct fraud awareness training and/or investigative research. The individual will work in the field and be provided with a company issued computer, phone and vehicle. This is a field position requiring work from home arrangement and daily travel throughout MA by company car.

This position's primary coverage territory is North of Boston (North Shore) so the preferred candidate will reside within this territory.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Conducts in-person interviews
  • Prepares clear, concise, detailed reports
  • Provides recommendations on the disposition of claims
  • Prepares cases for potential defense and/or prosecution
  • Examines and analyzes evidence to make recommendations on the acceptance or denial of claims
  • Protects the company assets and policyholders from fraudulent activity

title: Director, Data Products & Engineering
description:
The Director, Data Products & Engineering, leads the development, expansion, and delivery of Plymouth Rock’s enterprise data assets within the enterprise data lake on AWS. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of ingestion, transformation, and data availability pipelines and is measured on throughput, reliability, and speed of delivery. This role is responsible for ensuring that the enterprise data lake is complete, high-fidelity, low-latency, and continuously expanding to meet the needs of Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, and AI data services and consumption patterns.

Leader will partner closely with business and IT leaders, as well as the heads of Data Governance and Data Services, to ensure that Plymouth Rock’s data distribution and consumption are well organized, well governed, and accessible at speed and scale. This leader spends the majority of their time working within the data lake platform: reviewing pipeline designs, unblocking engineers, troubleshooting production issues, and driving delivery velocity of the data lake, all in service of the organization’s AI ambitions.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Product Strategy & Delivery

  • Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.
  • Define the processes needed to achieve operational excellence in all areas including process management, resiliency and quality
  • Conduct research of strategic & emerging trends, lead proofs of concept and continuously drive innovation across the team
  • Lead the development of enterprise data products aligned to business and domains, ensuring data is structured, accessible, and reusable.
  • Define and prioritize the data roadmap in alignment with business needs, AI/ML use cases, and platform evolution.

Continuous, Rapid Data Expansion (Depth & Breadth)

  • Execute ingestion of structured, unstructured, and streaming data sources into the lake, closing data leakage gaps by capturing data directly from frontline systems.

  • Own production reliability of the data lake: monitoring, incident response, root-cause resolution, and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Partner with application teams to eliminate data leakage by capturing all data generated by frontline systems.

Data Engineering & Platform Execution

  • Deep hands-on experience with core AWS data services, including S3, Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, Athena, Kinesis, and RDS/Aurora
  • Optimize the storage patterns of all enterprise data assets to ensure accessibility, cost efficiency, stability, and reliability, while ensuring that data is curated, standardized, partitioned, and stored in the appropriate layer of the Data Lake medallion architecture.
  • Ensure ingestion metadata (including process and lineage) is complete, accurate, and consistent with governance standards, and that business tools/processes hosting and applying business semantics at the appropriate point in curation are stable and fast.
  • Lead teams of data engineers and product owners responsible for ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data across the enterprise data warehouse and data lake.
  • Continuously improve data ingestion speed, pipeline reliability, and processing efficiency.
  • Embed business context into data product development, ensuring outputs are actionable and aligned to operational needs.
  • Partner with Data Governance & Architecture to ensure data products align with standards. Ensure consistent, well-organized documentation.

Agile Product Execution & Scaled Delivery

  • Organize data platform into an agile product structure.
  • Ensure products squads deliver incrementally and are accountable for measurable outcomes aligned to the objectives of the data office.
  • Establish and manage agile delivery practices, including sprint cycles, backlog prioritization, and release management.
  • Coordinate Applications, Data Services, and AI/ML teams ensuring alignment across interdependent data ingestion, and consumption workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Actuarial Science, Business Administration, or a related field required.

Experience Preferred

  • Expertise in agile development methods including implementing scale agile methods in a cross-functional environment.
  • P&C Insurance experience and working familiarity of insurance underwriting operations and platform systems preferred.

title: Project Manager
description:
VCCP Health is a specialist agency that was set up to bring greater strategic rigour and higher creative standards to healthcare communications. Our aim is to bring a Challenger Spirit to this sector, not settling for doing things as they’ve always been done, but rather looking at how things could be done differently. The agency works on prescription, OTC & wellness brands, developing the full range of materials required for communications aimed at healthcare professionals and consumers. The client portfolio spans human and animal health, and a wide range of therapy areas and markets. Wherever possible, we bring the most innovative approaches and thinking from the consumer agency to the world of healthcare.

The future of health

Advances in technology are driving and changing the way that we all communicate, and whether our target audience is consumers, healthcare professionals or any other stakeholder, integration is now crucial to all marketing communications: At VCCP “we believe it only works if it all works”.

As part of the VCCP Partnership, one of the leading consumer agencies, VCCP Health is perfectly positioned to be leading the way in this new era and transforming healthcare communications.

PROJECT MANAGER

THE BIGGER PICTURE:

VCCP is the global challenger network for challenger brands. With more than 1,500 people across 13 offices in North America, EMEA and APAC, we challenge conventions to deliver value for the world’s most ambitious organizations.

We believe transformation happens when everything works together. That’s why we bring specialists from every discipline - strategy, AI, data, media, digital, experience, branding, creativity, production, PR, CX, CRM, employee engagement and beyond - into one fully integrated network.

We were founded on the principles of simplicity, collaboration and un-preciousness, and we’ve grown by staying true to them. VCCP has topped the AAR’s annual new business ranking in 13 of the last 14 years and holds multiple Agency of the Year titles. Across every company and every capability, we share the same ambition: to challenge ourselves, challenge our clients and challenge the industry for the better.

Bring it on.

ABOUT VCCP HEALTH:

VCCP Health set out to transform the fortunes of Rx, OTC, and wellness brands. We create life-changing big ideas that work across every touchpoint in the customer journey. Our work has been widely recognized for both creativity and effectiveness. We are a dedicated team of in-house, award-winning healthcare specialists who work across the full spectrum of capabilities, including medical, strategy, and promotional and educational campaign development, targeting diverse audiences from patients and caregivers to HCPs and payers. We are incredibly proud to have worked with a range of brands across the Healthcare and MedTech industry including Novo Nordisk, Gilead, MSD, Edwards Lifesciences, Chiesi, Teva, Leo Pharma, and so much more.

OUR CULTURE:

VCCP has a unique culture, and we are looking for people who will make a positive contribution to this, therefore the candidate must have the following attributes:

  • A collaborative nature
  • An entrepreneurial spirit
  • Take pride in their work
  • An honest approach
  • Be un-precious and able to recognize that a good idea can come from anywhere
  • Take responsibility

OUR PURPOSE:

So what do we actually do? Put simply, we exist to transform the fortunes of our clients by challenging and disrupting the categories they operate in. It’s why we describe ourselves as ‘the challenger agency for challenger brands’.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an organized, proactive Project Manager to keep work moving at VCCP Health in the US. You will manage projects from brief to final delivery across HCP campaigns, patient materials, digital, print and congress, working with Account, Creative, Medical and Strategy teams and our production partners.

As a growing team, we also need you to keep an eye on resourcing: knowing who is working on what, spotting capacity clashes early and bringing recommendations to the table. Things change quickly here, so you’ll need to stay calm, flexible and solutions-focused.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Independently manage multichannel projects from initiation to deployment. Build and own project timelines, schedules and status reports for assigned brands, updating them as projects evolve.
  • Work with Account teams to scope projects and estimate hours and costs, then track budgets and flag scope creep early.
  • Oversee the medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) process: Help prepare materials for submission into Veeva PromoMats, track submission/review processes and schedules
  • Manage day-to-day workload across the creative team, and recommend how to shift resources between projects to meet deadlines.
  • Brief and manage third-party production partners (print, digital development, video and congress), validating estimates and keeping them on schedule.
  • Schedule and run internal status meetings and internal reviews, making sure work is signed off by the internal leads before it goes to the client.
  • Reconcile completed projects with Finance in a timely way.
  • Recommend improvements to processes and ways of working as the US team grows.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • 3-5 years of project management experience in an advertising agency, with pharmaceutical or healthcare agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of multichannel production across print, video and digital platforms.Experience with resourcing or traffic workflows.
  • Proficiency in Smartsheet and Google Workspace; experience with tools such as Workfront, Asana or Resource Guru is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills, with the confidence to challenge timelines or scope constructively and to escalate when needed.
  • Financial aptitude and experience in campaign launch processes preferred

ATTITUDE:

  • A passion for all things creative and advertising
  • Resilience to keep going in a fast paced environment
  • Strives for excellence
  • Can do attitude
  • Approachable and personable
  • Builds rapport and is able to quickly establish excellent working relationships
  • Team player

SALARY RANGE:

The salary range VCCP US believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting is $78,000 - $90,000 per year. Individual compensation is based on a range of factors, including but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, education, specialty, level of responsibility, internal equity, budget, tenure, performance, and business or organizational needs. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. If your requirements fall outside of this range, you are still welcome to apply. In addition to a competitive base salary, VCCP US offers full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes a variety of health benefit options, 401k company match that vests immediately, monthly cell phone stipend, a generous holiday schedule with both a summer and winter break, plus personal paid time off.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage starting the first of the month after your hire date
  • HSA and FSA options, including healthcare, dependent care and commuter accounts
  • 401(k) with a dollar for dollar match up to 4%, 100% vested immediately
  • Company paid basic life, AD&D and short term disability insurance
  • Paid time off starting at 3 weeks, plus sick days (mental health days included) and 22.5 company holidays, including an extended July 4th break and a winter break over the holidays

  • Employee discount programs

title: On-Site Fire Protection Technician - Mining
description:
The Hiller Companies, LLC has an immediate opening for On-Site Fire Protection Technician for Mining locations served by our Hiller Mining Team. If you are a dedicated professional with a passion for ﬁre protection and safety, we invite you to apply today.

The Hiller Companies is a leading provider of ﬁre protection and safety solutions, dedicated to safeguarding lives and property all around the world. Headquartered in Mobile, Alabama, Hiller extends its reach globally as well as in domestic markets with offices across the United States. With over 100 years in the industry, our mission is to ensure the highest standards of safety and innovation in comprehensive ﬁre protection services, including installation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of critical ﬁre and life safety equipment. Our team remains laser-focused on one goal – making the world a safer place.

Job Summary: An On-Site Fire Protection Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, testing, maintenance, and repair of ﬁre suppression systems on large mining equipment in accordance with industry standards and regulations.

Work Location: This position is based out of the Denver, CO area and will include travel to other mining locations in CO, largely day trips with little if any overnight travel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install and service fire suppression systems on large mining equipment such as haul trucks, drills, loaders, shovels, as well as fixed fire systems in buildings, conveyors, etc.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of system components to verify proper operation.
  • Prepare detailed reports documenting inspection ﬁndings, test results, and any related deﬁciencies or non-compliance issues observed, in accordance with NFPA codes and standards.
  • Troubleshoot system malfunctions and perform repairs as needed, identifying, and resolving issues with wiring, circuitry, devices, and software.
  • Respond promptly to service calls and emergency requests, diagnosing problems and implementing solutions to restore system functionality.

Provide all-source intel analyst support to Task Order in Baghdad, Iraq for the Department of State. Employees rotate in and out of country throughout the duration of their contract.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Intelligence Solutions Portfolio Lead
description:
Intelligence Solutions Portfolio Lead

Technergetics — Utica/Rome, NY area

Opportunity Overview

Technergetics is looking for the right candidate for this exciting new position. The Intelligence Solutions Portfolio Lead is a new leadership role responsible for establishing and growing a Technergetics business unit that brings the company's R&D talent and experience to the Intelligence Community (IC). The role combines business strategy, product vision, customer development, team management, and program oversight with responsibility for developing and growing the secure facilities needed to support the related business unit. The candidate will start from ground zero and is accountable for turning an opportunity into a revenue-generating unit.

Position Details

Salary Range: $185,000–$250,000 annually. The final offer depends on how many position qualifications the candidate meets, as well as education and experience. This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location and Travel

  • This position is located in Utica, NY.
  • It involves approximately 25% travel to customer and client sites within and outside the Utica-Rome, NY area.

Due to the security clearance required for this position, only U.S. citizens are eligible to apply, per Executive Order 12968 (Access to Classified Information).

Responsibilities and Duties

The successful candidate will have four duty areas:

Primary: Intelligence Business Unit Development and Oversight

  • Lead the creation of a new Technergetics business unit that applies the company's R&D talent, quantum and software expertise, and engineering experience to IC customers.
  • Define the unit's mission, target customers, strategy, service and solution offerings, and multi-year growth plan, and obtain leadership approval.
  • Work with company leadership to develop business unit plans, including revenue targets, staffing model, budget, and investment requirements.
  • Map existing company capabilities, technologies, and staff expertise to IC needs, and identify gaps to be closed through hiring, partnerships, or internal development.
  • Structure and staff the unit, working with Human Resources, program leadership, and hiring managers to define roles, recruit cleared talent, and establish reporting lines.
  • Once established, oversee the unit's day-to-day operations, program delivery, financial performance, and staff development.
  • Supervise and mentor unit staff, set objectives, and conduct performance reviews.
  • Report unit performance, risks, and opportunities to the President and executive leadership on a regular cadence.

Secondary Prime: Intelligence Facilities Development and Growth

  • Lead the planning, development, and growth of the facilities needed to support the company's IC portfolio, including secure workspaces and accredited spaces as customer and business requirements dictate.
  • Define facility requirements from customer, contract, and security standards, and translate them into scope, budgets, and timelines.
  • Work with the Facility Security Officer (FSO), company leadership, and government sponsors on accreditation and approval of secure spaces.
  • Support facility design, contractors, and vendors during planning and execution stages.
  • Align facility capacity and expansion with the unit's customer pipeline and staffing plan.
  • Maintain ongoing compliance of the unit's facilities with applicable security, safety, and contractual requirements.

Business Development and Customer Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with IC customers, prime contractors, and teaming partners.
  • Lead capture and proposal activities for IC opportunities, coordinating with other business units and technical leads.
  • Ensure pursuits and resulting contracts comply with applicable FAR/DFARS and customer security requirements.

Company Leadership and Coordination

  • Coordinate with R&D, software, and quantum team leads to ensure technical staff and capabilities are effectively applied to Intelligence work.
  • Participate in executive planning and contribute to company-wide strategy and growth decisions.
  • Initial supervisory scope will be small and is expected to grow with the unit.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

This position requires at minimum a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in computer science, computer engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, physics, cybersecurity, business, or a closely related discipline.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience, including significant work supporting the IC or comparable national security customers and operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the growth of a business unit, program, or line of business, with budget accountability.
  • Experience in classified operations and knowledge of secure facility requirements, including facility planning, build-out, or accreditation.
  • Strong understanding of the IC landscape, acquisition processes, and customer needs.
  • Business planning, financial management, and capture/proposal leadership skills.
  • Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS, NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117), and applicable facility security standards.
  • Ability to translate advanced R&D capabilities into customer-relevant solutions.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills at executive and customer levels.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced degree in engineering, computer science, physics, cybersecurity, business, or related field.
  • Direct experience designing or managing SCIFs or other accredited secure spaces.
  • Experience in quantum, software, AI, cyber, or advanced R&D environments.
  • Strong existing relationships within the IC, Department of War (DoW), and industry.

Clearance

Active Top Secret clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain one, is required, with eligibility for SCI access. U.S. citizenship is required. Clearance level to be confirmed with the Facility Security Officer and company leadership.

Benefits

Our benefits package includes health, life, disability, dental, and vision insurance, plus a 401(k) plan with a 3% company contribution and 3% company match.

Additional perks include:

  • Generous Paid Time Off, including a PTO “gift day” for your birthday
  • 11 federal holidays per year
  • Three weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Annual technology allowance
  • Referral bonuses and professional recognition awards
  • Healthcare stipends
  • Tuition/education reimbursement (once eligibility requirements are met)
  • Flexible daily start and stop times for most projects and positions

Company Description

Technergetics is a U.S.-based company headquartered in Utica, NY, with employees and clients located throughout the country. The Utica/Rome area is a hub of cutting-edge cyber technology research, bolstered by the Griffiss Business & Technology Park's tenants and facilities, including the Air Force Research Lab (AFRL). At Technergetics, we work with a wide variety of technologies, including mobile and web apps, quantum computing, machine learning and artificial intelligence, AI-enabled edge devices, and more.

Technergetics will never extend an offer of employment without a thorough interview process that includes a face-to-face interview — either in person or via a virtual Teams meeting — from an official Technergetics email address (@techngs.com). If you receive correspondence from any other email address, it is a scam.

Technergetics does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Business Manager
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Business Manager is a designated Key Personnel position supporting the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) Protective Force subcontract. The Business Manager leads financial and business administration, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, payroll and billing support, procurement coordination, management reporting, and workforce and resource planning. The role serves as a business liaison among program and site leadership, the M&O Contractor, and Constellis corporate functions to maintain financial accountability, support efficient contract execution, and ensure compliant, audit-ready business operations. The incumbent must meet subcontract Key Personnel qualification requirements and is subject to M&O approval.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead program budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting across SPR Protective Force activities and contract locations.
  • Support annual budget requests for staffing, labor, equipment, services, and other resources, and identify cost-saving opportunities and fiscal impacts.
  • Maintain cost tracking and variance analysis and prepare recurring labor reports, including weekly overtime reporting and monthly payroll or labor-hour summaries by site.
  • Manage and coordinate general accounting, payroll support, accounts payable, billing, accruals, reconciliations, month-end close, and related financial reporting.
  • Manage Costpoint-related business activities, including requisitions, charge codes, cost allocation, financial tracking, and reporting.
  • Prepare executive reports, presentations, forecasts, and analyses addressing financial performance, operational metrics, risks, trends, and program outlook.
  • Maintain audit-ready financial, procurement, payroll, and business records; support internal, external, customer, and government audits; and monitor compliance with internal controls.
  • Coordinate procurement and requisition activities for equipment, materials, supplies, facilities support, and services in accordance with company, M&O, contractual, and approval requirements.
  • Support accountability and financial control of Government-furnished and subcontractor-provided property and other program resources.
  • Coordinate with Human Resources and Recruiting on workforce transition, hiring, onboarding, personnel administration, staffing readiness, and labor-cost impacts.
  • Support administration of approved compensation, benefits, travel, relocation, employee-relations, and labor-related processes in coordination with Human Resources and program leadership.
  • Develop and maintain business SOPs and internal controls and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, strengthen controls, and improve operating efficiency.
  • Establish and monitor key business metrics and provide data-driven recommendations to the Project Manager and program leadership.
  • Serve as the primary business partner to SPR program leadership, site leadership, and Constellis corporate Finance, Human Resources, Recruiting, Procurement, and other functional organizations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of successful contract execution.

WORKING AND PHYSICAL CONDITIONS

  • Work is primarily performed in an office environment with routine travel to SPR program locations in Louisiana and Texas as required.
  • The position may require work outside normal business hours to support month-end close, audits, transition or mobilization activities, and urgent program requirements.
  • The incumbent must be able to access DOE and SPR facilities and comply with applicable site security, safety, and access requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • U.S. citizenship and ability to meet contract and DOE site-access requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Accounting or Finance.
  • Minimum of 10 years of financial and/or business-related experience, including at least 5 years in a management capacity.
  • Broad knowledge of financial disciplines, automated business systems, accounting procedures, and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated experience in finance, general accounting, payroll, accounts payable, billing, and logistics, with a strong emphasis on forecasting and analysis.
  • Extensive experience using automated accounting systems, spreadsheets, databases, Microsoft PowerPoint, web-based systems, and business-reporting tools.
  • Professional written, verbal, interpersonal, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve conflicting demands, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the DOE security clearance required for Key Personnel and successfully complete contract-required background, drug, and security screening.
  • Valid driver's license.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA).
  • Prior financial or business-management experience in a U.S. Government contracting environment.
  • Experience supporting DOE, NNSA, SPR, protective-force, or other highly regulated government programs.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint or a comparable government-contracting accounting and enterprise resource planning system.

BENEFITS

Constellis offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects its commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

title: UGC Creator Manager
description:
Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education. We build market-leading, online college credit and test-preparation solutions that help working adults earn their degrees, advance their careers, and achieve economic mobility. Recognized by Fast Company and GSV 150 as one of the world’s most innovative education companies, we are also at the forefront of AI-first learning, combining artificial intelligence with the latest learning science to improve access and outcomes at scale.

Our product is our impact. Through our Keys to College and Keys to the Classroom initiatives, we have saved students over $700 million in tuition and enabled hundreds of thousands of learners to pursue and succeed in careers across nursing, teaching, counseling, business, and other high-demand fields. We are deeply focused on measurable outcomes and building products that create meaningful, lasting change in people’s lives.

About the role

Millions of learners use Study.com to earn college credit, pass certification exams and move ahead in their careers. Many have a story worth telling, and they are the best people to tell it.

The Creator Program Manager (UGC) will be responsible for making sure that Study.com’s customer voices are authentically integrated across multiple social media channels, as well as work with creator partners to reach audiences who Study.com best serves. This person will effectively build the engine that sources current and past customers who have the potential to become effective creator partners. This role balances scaled outreach with coaching and developing resources to grow the customer voices pipeline, with management of long-term creator relationships and creator campaign execution. You'll use AI tooling and automated outreach to surface real outcomes, bring people in as partners, and develop the best customer voices into valuable creators for our channels.

You'll feed a content engine producing thousands of high-quality videos a year across 10+ verticals and 30+ TikTok, Instagram and YouTube channels. Success takes a builder's mindset, hands-on AI fluency, and a social-native mindset.

This role is based in our Mountain View, CA office and is hybrid in office Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

Key responsibilities

  • Build the program. Define who we recruit, how we reach them, what we ask from them, and what they get. Make it repeatable at scale.
  • Social Strategy. Elevate social content produced by customer and creator partners through your expertise in trends, formats, platform updates, and cultural movements.
  • Turn customer stories into content worth posting. Find learners and partners with real outcomes (credit earned, exams passed, careers changed) across every vertical we serve and translate their stories into scroll-stopping content.
  • Manage partner production. Take customer partners from "yes" to their first published video fast, with the brand basics and approved claims they need to deliver our value.
  • Develop playbooks for customer voices. Build guides, trainings and feedback that sharpen hooks, storytelling and filming, without writing their voice for them.
  • Grow talent. Spot the strongest creators early, coach them to their potential, and work with our social video leads to determine who is consistently featured.
  • Hit volume and quality targets. Generate a steady flow of authentic content into our channels, and work with the social and content teams so the best voices land in the right places.
  • Measure and report. Track volume, quality, retention and the conversion metrics, and turn the results into clear recommendations.
  • Manage payments and compliance. Run a simple pay structure with Finance and make sure every creator follows disclosure rules and approved claims.

AI Systems & Program Scaling

  • Automated discovery. Set up the systems that find and score potential creators from our customer base, reviews, communities and social platforms.
  • Outreach at scale. Run personalized, automated outreach to thousands of prospects, and route the most promising to a real conversation.
  • AI-assisted vetting. Screen applications and sample content for story strength, on-camera presence, and brand fit.
  • Content prompting. Generate prompts, story angles and brief templates tied to our verticals to leverage effective formats and trends.
  • Quality at scale. Develop AI checks so every piece is accurate, compliant and channel-ready before it publishes.
  • Continuous improvement. Collaborate with our AI Ops team. Automate what repeats and refine what works, using and extending our in-house tools, so the program grows without getting heavier.

Required qualifications

  • 2+ years in UGC, creator programs, influencer marketing or social-first growth, including building a program from scratch.
  • Strong, proven skills in creator discovery and in building and amplifying brand presence through UGC and social media.
  • Hands-on experience building AI and automation workflows (i.e. outreach, scoring, prompt design), not just using the chat tools.
  • Deep, current fluency in TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
  • A coach's touch: you help people tell their own story in their own voice.
  • A builder's mindset: you create systems, templates and trainings that scale into a program.
  • Strong analytical instincts: you balance data and creativity, optimizing performance as a whole for conversion, not just views.
  • Able to work on site in Mountain View 3 days per week and own a function as it takes shape.

Nice to Have: experience with creator CRM or UGC platforms; hands-on content production experience, and experience in education or another category where claims are regulated.

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125,000 per year. Pay is dependent upon factors including skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands.

title: Collections Coordinator
description:
The Hiller Companies, LLC has an immediate opening for Collections Coordinator. If you are a dedicated professional with a passion for fire protection and safety, we invite you to apply today.

The Hiller Companies is a leading provider of fire protection and safety solutions, dedicated to safeguarding lives and property all around the world. Headquartered in Mobile, Alabama, Hiller extends its reach globally as well as in domestic markets with offices across the United States. With over 100 years in the industry, our mission is to ensure the highest standard of safety and innovation in comprehensive fire protection services, including installation, inspection, maintenance and repair of critical fire and life safety equipment. Our team remains laser-focused on one goal - making the world a safer place.

Job Summary: The Collections Coordinator is responsible for managing and resolving account receivable balances within an assigned portfolio while ensuring the timely and efficient collection of debts owed to the company.

Pay Range: $23.00/hour - $26.00/hour. The posted salary range reflects the anticipated hiring range for this position at the time of posting and is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual starting pay will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, education, internal equity, geographic location (where applicable), and market considerations. Not all candidates will be hired at the top of the posted range. The posted range reflects base salary only and does not include any applicable bonuses, commissions, overtime, or the value of employee benefits. Eligible employees may participate in the Company's benefit programs, subject to the terms and eligibility requirements of each plan.

Location/Schedule: This position is a US-Based Fully Remote position, supporting Hiller locations in multiple time zones. Must be able to commit to full time work schedule supporting office hours in the Mountain time zone.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with customers via telephone and email about overdue payments in a friendly and professional manner, using tact and empathy to encourage customers to make payments while maintaining positive relationships.
  • Encourage customers to make online payments via website portal and provide guidance in navigating the system.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve billing discrepancies, address any issues affecting collections, and meet monthly collection goals.
  • Conduct account reconciliations to make sure all outstanding balances are accurate in the accounting system and keep accurate notes in customer accounts. If any discrepancies or disputes are identified, resolve them quickly and efficiently.
  • Work with reports on collections performance, overdue and aging receivables, and key metrics including Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), percent current, and bad debt reserves. Track any areas of improvement, report results to management and escalate problem accounts.
  • Create awareness for opportunities to streamline the collections processes, boost efficiency, and continuously improve the customer experience.
  • Stay informed on any changes in regulations to ensure that collections practices follow all legal requirements. File bankruptcy claims on local jurisdictions as needed.
  • While working on collections, maintain focus on keeping positive relationships with customers. Aim to resolve any issues and disputes amicably whenever possible.

  • Mentor and provide direction to other Process Efficiency Analysts on process mapping approach and project management discipline

  • Proactively surface systemic process or ownership gaps across Claims, not just within your assigned projects

What Success Looks Like

You are the person Ksenia and claims leadership can hand an ambiguous, high-stakes initiative to — something like Total Loss modernization — and trust that it will be scoped correctly, staffed appropriately, and driven to completion without close supervision. A year in, at least one major initiative you owned should be fully implemented, with a clear operating model in place and documented ownership for what happens next.

Qualifications

  • Strong ability to build process maps and ownership models from scratch in an environment with limited existing documentation
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including comfort presenting recommendations directly to senior leadership
  • Practical understanding of claims systems and how process design decisions interact with system constraints
  • Sound judgment on when to move forward independently versus when to escalate

Preferred (Not Required)

  • Direct experience with claims management systems such as Sapiens ClaimsPro, ImageRight, or comparable platforms
  • Experience specifically with total loss, salvage, or vehicle valuation processes
  • Formal process-improvement credentials (Lean, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt) or project management credentials (PMP)

Salary Range

title: Maintenance Mechanical Technician

title: VP, Revenue Growth Management
description:

Want to make an impact?

The role requires a strong balance of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, change management, and commercial influence to accelerate profitable growth, strengthen customer partnerships, and foster transparent communication on Revenue Growth & Trade Management across the organization.

This role is based at our global headquarters in Chicago, IL.

Ways you will make a difference

The following are representative but not exhaustive of the objectives and responsibilities of the position.

Revenue Growth Strategy & Value Maneuver

  • Serve as the enterprise leader and process owner for Revenue Growth Management and the local Value Maneuver agenda across pricing, revenue management, channel management, and NPD value-chain decisions
  • Lead, in close partnership with Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Category Leadership, the annual and long-range definition of the Value Maneuver to deliver sustainable, profitable growth
  • Translate corporate growth ambition into clear revenue, trade, pricing, promotion, and channel priorities that can be executed through the commercial planning cycle

Pricing, Trade Investment & Promotion Effectiveness

  • Develop pricing architecture, pack-price strategy, and revenue management recommendations that strengthen brand health, category growth, competitiveness, and margin delivery
  • Provide strategic leadership for trade investment guardrails, promotional planning, post-event analysis, and optimization of trade spend effectiveness across channels and customers

Commercial Planning & Customer Partnership

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Key Account Management teams in customer review processes, providing RGM recommendations and supporting preparation of customer scorecards covering the triple-win of consumer, customer, and company value
  • Support Sales teams throughout the planning process with clear inputs and guidelines on pricing, promotion, innovation, merchandising, and customer investment priorities
  • Influence Joint Business Planning and customer growth strategies by translating RGM insights into persuasive, customer-ready recommendations

Commercial Capabilities, Compliance & Business Intelligence

  • Act as the local focal point for commercial capabilities, driving adoption of tools, processes, and standards aligned to Sales and Order-to-Cash policy
  • Ensure availability, accuracy, and usability of the data required to maintain RGM and commercial capabilities at local level, including sell-out, market share, customer performance, pricing, promotion, trade, and margin data
  • Lead development and enhancement of dashboards and reporting that monitor key commercial figures and support business understanding, decision-making, and accountability

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Operate as a senior commercial thought partner to the Chief Customer Officer and Sales Leadership Team, shaping priorities that improve revenue quality and profitable growth
  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Category Leadership, Supply Chain, and Sales Operations

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Deliver results through a high-performing Revenue Growth Management team by providing strategic direction, coaching, problem solving, and clear accountability
  • Recruit, manage, motivate, coach, and develop team members, building the capability required to sustain the company’s profitability, growth goals, and vision

Skills that will make you successful

title: Bridge Crane Operator
description:
Job Title: ERH Bridge Crane Operator

Classification: Non-Exempt

Department: Plant-4

Job Code: SD34

Revised Date: 7/22/16

  1. Primary Function:

Under leadership/direction perform a range of functions concerning the material handling of mandrels of ERH material. Will remove green, wrapped mandrels to train and retrieve vulcanized mandrels for staging at AGV locations. Fill in for Material Handling Coordinator when he’s not available.

  1. Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Load vulcanizer carts with green, wrapped mandrels using bridge crane.
  • Unload vulcanized mandrels from cart using bridge crane.
  • Stage vulcanized mandrels at AGV pick up/drop off locations.
  • Operate AGVS transterms.
  • Properly identify vulcanized materials.
  • Spiral wrap green mandrels and remove the gantry/bridge crane.
  • Keep like products together in AGVS.
  • Communicate with others, as necessary.
  • Maintain proper housekeeping and safety precautions.

  • Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
    • Essential Full Performance Knowledge:
  1. Required knowledge includes, but is not limited to, operation of bridge crane and gantry crane, bar code system, AGV system, spiral wrapper and wrapping techniques, minor maintenance of equipment, safety systems and housekeeping.

  • Essential Full Performance Skills:

  1. Reading – barcode/AGV system prompts, cure tickets, etc.
  2. Data entry in the AGV system transterms.
  • Communication – able to give and receive instructions, participate in group problem solving.
  1. Operation of spiral wrapper.
  2. Operation of bridge crane.
  3. Operation of gantry crane.

  • Essential Full Performance Abilities: N/A

  1. Equipment/Data: bridge crane, gantry crane, spiral wrapper, AGV transterm and barcode system.

  1. Equipment Operated: bridge crane, gantry crane, spiral wrapper, AGV transterm and barcode system.

Data Used: AGV, barcode prompts

Materials Used: broom, dust pan.

Interactions with Others: All as needed.

  • Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Education: High School diploma

Equivalency: GED

  • Experience: 3 to 12 months holding a chair for this position as defined in the Seniority System Handbook.

Equivalency: N/A

  • Work Environment/Time Worked:
    • Work Environment: Activities occur inside a rubber manufacturing facility. Job conditions include but are not limited to exposure to the following.
      1. Potential for temperature exceeding 100°F during the summer.
      2. Airborne mica dust.
  • Pinch hazard from moving parts.
  1. Possible burns from hot mandrels just out of the vulcanizers (270°)
  2. Confined spaces when loading and unloading cure carts.
  3. Heavy equipment operated includes bridge and gantry cranes.
  • Major electrical current associated with bridge crane power ways.

  • Time Worked:
    1. Hours Worked:
      1. Typically, 40 hours per week with overtime required as production ticket dictates.
    2. Days of Week Worked:
      1. Typically, Monday through Friday with Saturday and/or Sunday work required as production ticket dictates.
  • Shifts Worked:
    1. 3 shift operation required (10:30 PM to 7:00 AM; 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM; 3:30 PM to 10:30 PM).

  1. Physical Requirements:

  • Climbing – may occasionally need to climb on cure cart for various reasons.
  • Stooping – stoop to get building ticket out of mandrel wrap.
  • Reaching – to assist in putting mandrel in cart.
  • Standing – stands for vast majority of shift.
  • Walking – walk from spiral wrappers to train back to spiral wrappers most of the day using the bridge crane.
  • Pushing – push mandrel into place.
  • Pulling – pull mandrel to rotate it proper orientation. Lifting – occasional lift of spiral wrap (> 100 pounds).
  • Fingering – push buttons on control pendant of bridge crane and gantry crane most of the day.
  • Grasping – grasp mandrel before rotating; grasp control pendant.
  • Feeling – feel temperature of vulcanized rubber/hot mandrels.
  • Talking – must communicate with other members of the plant. Participate in group problem solving discussions.
  • Hearing – see Talking L.
  • Repetitive motion – a lot of repeated finger movements to control pendant for bridge and gantry cranes.
  • Seeing – see hazards, warnings, SDS’s, etc.

Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The AI Engineering Intern will support Constellis’ Enterprise AI Transformation initiatives by assisting with the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning, generative AI, and data science solutions. This graduate-level internship will provide hands-on experience working with enterprise data, AI workflow automation, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, analytics, and secure AI application development in support of business, compliance, and operational use cases.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in developing machine learning models, data science workflows, and AI-enabled prototypes that support enterprise use cases across business functions.
  • Support data preparation, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, model training, testing, validation, and performance monitoring activities.
  • Contribute to generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflow experiments using approved enterprise platforms, data sources, and development practices.
  • Assist with evaluation of model quality, grounded-answer accuracy, task success, hallucination risk, bias, explainability, and operational reliability.
  • Develop reusable scripts, notebooks, documentation, dashboards, and technical summaries to communicate findings, assumptions, results, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Information Technology, AI Enterprise Transformation, business stakeholders, data stewards, and application teams to translate business problems into practical AI and analytics solutions.
  • Work is typically based in a busy office environment and subject to frequent interruptions. Business work hours are Monday-Friday standard core hours; however, some extended hours may be required based on project needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related technical field.
  • Coursework or project experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI, data mining, optimization, or predictive analytics.
  • Experience with Python and common data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, APIs, cloud services, version control, notebooks, model evaluation, and responsible AI concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
